name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I’m respectfully asking you to help my husband, Mark Kelly, knock his FEC deadline fundraising goal out of the park. Will you pitch in anything you can before midnight TOMORROW?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Friends —
I’m reaching out today to ask you to support my husband, Mark, with a contribution before his FEC deadline ends tomorrow at midnight. He needs your help to hold Arizona’s Senate seat. Please, give me a chance to explain why this is so important.
I personally know just how hard these campaigns can be. National Republicans see people like Mark, who is independent and puts his constituents first, as a problem. That’s why we have always known that outside groups would come out of the woodwork to spend untold amounts of money to try and take back this Senate seat in 2022.
And they’ve already started.
One of Mark’s opponents has the backing of a $10 million super PAC. Another has promised to personally spend $50 million in this race. National Republicans have already spent millions of dollars attacking Mark. And Donald Trump flew to Arizona to hold a rally and said, “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
So, it's clear Trump and National Republicans are already ramping up their efforts to beat Mark.
Mark needs our help to fight off these attacks, and the best way to do that is by lots and lots of people contributing what they can before tomorrow night’s FEC fundraising deadline comes to an end.
We set a goal of 100,000 contributions this month and can’t afford to fall short, so what do you say?
[**If you are able, will you make a $3 donation to Mark’s people-powered campaign before this FEC deadline ends? We set a 100,000 contribution goal because we want to show the strength of this campaign, thousands of people like you chipping in a few bucks at a time. We’re counting on you to help get us there.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-dec21?refcode=em211230-3-30&t=1&refcode2=1881_6688874_PVhvO5&akid=1881%2E6688874%2EPVhvO5)

| **[Donate $100](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-dec21?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode=em211230-3-30&t=23&refcode2=1881_6688874_PVhvO5&akid=1881%2E6688874%2EPVhvO5)**

****
| | **[Donate $250](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-dec21?express_lane=true&amount=250&refcode=em211230-3-30&t=24&refcode2=1881_6688874_PVhvO5&akid=1881%2E6688874%2EPVhvO5)**
---
****
| **[Other Amount](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mek-em-dec21?express_lane=true&refcode=em211230-3-30&t=25&refcode2=1881_6688874_PVhvO5&akid=1881%2E6688874%2EPVhvO5)**

Mark is working so hard for Arizona in the Senate. To hold this seat, he is going up against National Republicans and outside groups that want to stop us. That’s why your support, no matter the amount, is greatly appreciated by me, Mark, and the whole team.
I can’t thank you enough for the amount of support you’ve shown so far — now, let’s keep up the momentum before this FEC deadline ends tomorrow at midnight.
All my best,
Gabby Giffords

---
| | | Folks,

**January 6th is the one-year anniversary of the darkest day of our democracy’s recent history. **

It’s the day that Donald Trump and his allies like Scott Fitzgerald, then a brand-new Congressman whose first substantive vote was to overturn a lawful election, empowered and encouraged a group to storm the United States Capitol in an attempted coup.

That day demonstrated to all of us just how far our fragile democracy has been eroded, and how critical it is that we protect it.

**That’s why I’m inviting you to join us on the anniversary of the Capitol Insurrection on Thursday, January 6th at 5:30 PM, at the Waukesha Dems office, as I roll out a comprehensive plan to restore and strengthen our Democracy. **
---
|
---
| Join us as Mike rolls out his plan on **RESTORING OUR DEMOCRACY**
on the anniversary of the insurrection

**_THURSDAY, JANUARY 6TH_
5:30 pm | **Outdoor flag waving
**6:00 pm |** Indoor program*

[**WAUKESHA DEMS OFFICE**
336 Wisconsin Ave,
Waukesha, WI 53186](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=b5be330042&e=356c0699dd)

* Indoor attendance will be limited to ensure social distancing. All attendees must be vaccinated and remain masked at all times they are indoors.

---
|
---
| **Our democracy is not set in stone. It’s fragile, and the events of the last four years have brought it dangerously close to its breaking point. **

Doing nothing is no longer an option. It’s past time for us to stand up and take our democracy back.

I hope you can join me on the 6th as I roll out my comprehensive plan to do just that.

I’ll see you then,

Mike Van Someren

| | Dear ,
Can you believe it?

It’s almost 2022. And what a roller coaster of a year. But I tell you what, as bad as 2021 was, “led” by the Democrats, 2022 will be a historically great year, especially for Republicans!

**But this requires and depends on us defending our elections next year. If we do not, it doesn’t matter what the people want and need!**

[_And that’s why I am writing you today. We have just 24 hours left to hit our critical fundraising goal of $15,280. We need this money to push for election integrity in 2022!_](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=ccc104cfa9&e=44b8c466b0)
_[Help us today with a generous donation!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=ce8b003278&e=44b8c466b0)_

This is the most important deadline of our campaign BY FAR.

_We are fighting against a fake news Media that wants to silence us and countless Soros bucks, ready and willing to flood Arizona._

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi Peter — I’m
Charles’ mother, Earletta Hearn. I’m writing to you today to ask if you
can do a big favor for my son CJ.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14363?refcode=em20211230-1391&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=1391%2E346206%2EcVuQOm ][IMG]

I recently spoke with Charles’ campaign team and they informed me that
they’re currently 64% of the way toward their big end-of-year fundraising
goal. They’re trying to raise 5,000 grassroots donations by December 31 to
make sure we’re ready for every challenge ahead of us in 2022 to replace
Rand Paul.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14363?refcode=em20211230-1391&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=1391%2E346206%2EcVuQOm ]I know it would mean a lot to the team and Charles if I helped today
to raise some money for this fundraising goal. So I’m asking: Will you
chip in $5 or anything you can so we can send Charles and
our bold, people-first agenda to the Senate next year?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14363?refcode=em20211230-1391&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1391%2E346206%2EcVuQOm ]Contribute $5

I know in my heart that if we want a fighter in the Senate, someone who
will look out for families like yours and mine, there’s no one better than
my CJ.

Life wasn’t always easy for us.

When my son Charles was growing up, there were even times when I would
skip meals so he could eat. We couldn’t always afford to have presents at
Christmas. At one point, we didn’t have a place to live because our house
burned down. Those days were hard, and I don’t wish them on anyone. But I
know for a fact those experiences never left Charles — they’re what drive
him every single day.

That’s why Charles won’t rest until we pass Medicare for All and make sure
everyone has access to free, quality health care.

That’s why Charles is fighting to make sure all of our families have
enough money in our pockets to pay for rent and eat dinner every night.

And that’s why Charles is running to replace Rand Paul next year so he can
fight for regular people in the Senate.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14363?refcode=em20211230-1391&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1391%2E346206%2EcVuQOm ]It’s important we show the strength of our movement and widespread
support Charles has before the year ends. Will you make a donation right
now — of any amount — to help the campaign reach their 5,000 donor goal?

Let’s do this,

Ms. Hearn

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20211230-1391-footer&t=1024&refcode2=1391_346206_cVuQOm&akid=1391%2E346206%2EcVuQOm

name: Trump News HQ
subject: Flawed and outdated?
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history.
_Sponsored message_
This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp7oi0g7luhkptpljlnt1q76ni382potf5baqvko_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjgm1pb0clh2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr031qku5a06k2tc1qflq0jqpq7gf10j8sfpmnho_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjgm1pb0clh2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z5mucfnm9j8vn47ppmrmp686o5f89foratpqdlfo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjgm1pb0clh2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

subject: Judicial Watch Court Victory!
body: Happy New Year! [INSIDE JW] JUDICIAL WATCH SUES MARYLAND FOR GERRYMANDERED CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICTS – VOTERS CHALLENGE UNCONSTITUTIONAL PLAN [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=26540&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1MUUlHRnpDdG9oOCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] Although everything seems to slow down during the holidays, we have been busy on your behalf. We just filed a lawsuit for 12 Maryland voters who object to a 2021 congressional redistricting plan because it diminishes their rights to participate in elections equally with other voters in violation of the state’s Constitution. (We are assisted by William J. Holtzinger, Esq., of Frederick, Maryland.) Our new lawsuit (_Parrott et al. v Lamone et al. _ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=26524&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3BhcnJvdHQtZXQtYWwtdi1sYW1vbmUtZXQtYWwtY29tcGxhaW50LTg2ODMzOTcvXShObz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==. 8683397)) details: Maryland’s recent history of partisan gerrymandering is no secret. [Its 2011] congressional district map ... remains one of the most notorious partisan gerrymanders in U.S. history. A federal district judge openly doubted that it could provide “fair and effective representation for all citizens.” Another called it “absurd” to suggest ‘that there is a community of interest” in a district described as a “Rorschach-like eyesore.” [A federal appeals court] famously described the same district as “a broken-winged pterodactyl, lying prostrate across the center of the state.” The lawsuit relates that a bipartisan commission recommended a map to Maryland Governor Larry Hogan on November 5 that he approved, but the legislature passed a different proposal in a straight party-line vote. On December 9, 2021, Hogan vetoed this proposal, and, the same day, the state legislature overrode his veto on another party-line vote. Our suit points out that the new map “is similar to the gerrymandered map that was the subject of universal abuse ten years ago as the worst gerrymander in the country.” The lawsuit details how the map distorts district lines, deviates from and crosses existing political boundaries, and fractures and divides communities of interest: Maryland’s Plan splits Anne Arundel County into three congressional districts. The middle of Anne Arundel County is ... connected to the Eastern Shore’s First Congressional District. The two areas are held together solely via the Chesapeake Bay Bridge.... Baltimore is divided among three congressional districts.... Montgomery County is divided among four congressional districts.... A roughly 20-mile trip north on the Baltimore-Washington Parkway from Cheverly, Maryland, a DC suburb, to Jessup, Maryland, an area outside [BWI] Airport, would cross congressional boundaries six times and lead a traveler through five different congressional districts. The lawsuit highlights how Maryland’s Fifth District features an “umbilical cord” designed to include Democratic voters in College Park to “counterbalance” the more Republican voters in the southern part of the state. And the Sixth Congressional District connects Garrett County, “the westernmost rural county which borders Pennsylvania and West Virginia,” with Potomac, Maryland, a wealthy DC suburb: As a federal court commented about the Sixth District in 2011, which made a similar linkage between these populations, it brings together voters “who have an interest in farming, mining, tourism, paper production, and the hunting of bears ... with voters who abhor the hunting of bears and do not know what a coal mine or paper mill even looks like.” These two groups have “different climate[s], root for different sports teams, and read different newspapers.” Outside experts agree that the plan is flawed, with the nonpartisan Princeton Gerrymandering Project giving it a grade of “F” for fairness and geographic compactness. In 2020, Republicans accounted for approximately 35% of Maryland’s Congressional votes, but they're unlikely to win even a single seat under this plan. This outcome wouldn't be possible without political gerrymandering. We argue that the plan violates Article 7 of the Maryland Declaration of Rights, which guarantees voters the right to “free and frequent” elections and the “right of suffrage.” Article 7 has been held to be “even more protective of rights of political participation than the provisions of the federal Constitution.” Additionally, the plan violates Article III, Section 4 of the Maryland Constitution, which provides that, “Each legislative district shall consist of adjoining territory, be compact in form, and of substantially equal population. Due regard shall be given to natural boundaries and the boundaries of political subdivisions.” Unfortunately, Democrats in the legislature went beyond politics to abuse of power in setting up Maryland’s gerrymandered congressional maps. This lawsuit seeks to protect the rights of all voters and citizens. Simply put: politicians shouldn’t get to pick their voters. JUDICIAL WATCH WINS APPEAL ON RELEASE OF SALLY YATES’ RECORDS ON REFUSAL TO ENFORCE PRESIDENT TRUMP’S TRAVEL BAN The corrupt acts of Obama holdovers against President Trump were some of the worst corruption cases in American history. So it was nice to see U.S. Court of Appeals for District of Columbia Circuit order [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=26516&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtc3RhdGUteWF0ZXMtZGVjaXNpb24tMDA4MzItMDUzMDQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz] a lower court to directly review records withheld by the Justice Department about former Acting Attorney General Sally Yates related to her outrageous 2017 refusal to enforce President Donald Trump’s travel ban executive order (_Judicial Watch vs. U.S. Department of Justice_ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=26517&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubGVhZ2xlLmNvbS9kZWNpc2lvbi9pbmZjbzIwMjExMjEwMTI5P3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz] (No. 20-5304)). The appellate court reversed a lower court ruling that the Justice Department could withhold certain records under the Freedom of Information Act’s Exemption 5 [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=22077&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3Yvb2lwL2Jsb2cvZm9pYS11cGRhdGUtcG9saWN5LWd1aWRhbmNlLXdoZW4tYXNzZXJ0LWRlbGliZXJhdGl2ZS1wcml2aWxlZ2UtdW5kZXItZm9pYS1leGVtcHRpb24tZml2ZT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] “deliberative process privilege,” which can be used to keep secret “pre-decisional” agency records. The appeals court ordered the lower court to directly review the records at issue _in camera_ to determine if they qualify for withholding as “deliberative.” We appealed [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=26518&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcveWF0ZXMtcmVjb3Jkcy1taXNjb25kdWN0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==] the district court’s ruling on February 11, 2021. At issue are four records described as “working drafts” of a January 30, 2017, statement by Yates instructing DOJ officials not to defend the executive order issued by then-President Trump. Trump fired Yates for insubordination after she issued the one-page statement [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=22075&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9hc3NldHMuZG9jdW1lbnRjbG91ZC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzLzM0Mzg4NzkvTGV0dGVyLUZyb20tU2FsbHktWWF0ZXMucGRmP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz]. The “working drafts” were sent as attachments in a chain of emails sent without messages between Yates and her deputy Matthew Axelrod. We filed a May 2017 FOIA lawsuit [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=3600&F=T&] after the DOJ failed to respond to a February 2017 FOIA request seeking Yates’ emails from her government account (_Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice_ [https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=57521&L=4727&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnQtYXJjaGl2ZS9qdy12LWRvai15YXRlcy1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDA4MzIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz] (No. 1:17-cv-00832)) for the time period she served as Acting Attorney General for President Trump. In our appeal, we highlighted how the Justice Department was undermining the FOIA reforms passed into law Congress under the FOIA Improvements Act in 2016 that “established a new, heightened standard of proof that agencies must meet when making discretionary withholdings of records requested under FOIA. The Declaration of Independence was only six months old. Washington knew that something had to be done, and he did it. “Courage is contagious,” the evangelist Billy Graham said. “When a brave man takes a stand, the spines of others are often stiffened.” As we cross over into a new year, with chilling winds all about, we are called to press on with courage. [INSIDE JW] JUDICIAL WATCH SUES MARYLAND FOR GERRYMANDERED CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICTS – VOTERS CHALLENGE UNCONSTITUTIONAL PLAN [==] Although everything seems to slow down during the holidays, we have been busy on your behalf. We just filed a lawsuit for 12 Maryland voters who object to a 2021 congressional redistricting plan because it diminishes their rights to participate in elections equally with other voters in violation of the state’s Constitution. (We are assisted by William J. Holtzinger, Esq., of Frederick, Maryland.) Our new lawsuit (Parrott et al. v Lamone et al. [==. 8683397)) details: Maryland’s recent history of partisan gerrymandering is no secret. [Its 2011] congressional district map ... remains one of the most notorious partisan gerrymanders in U.S. history. A federal district judge openly doubted that it could provide “fair and effective representation for all citizens.” Another called it “absurd” to suggest ‘that there is a community of interest” in a district described as a “Rorschach-like eyesore.” [A federal appeals court] famously described the same district as “a broken-winged pterodactyl, lying prostrate across the center of the state.” The lawsuit relates that a bipartisan commission recommended a map to Maryland Governor Larry Hogan on November 5 that he approved, but the legislature passed a different proposal in a straight party-line vote. On December 9, 2021, Hogan vetoed this proposal, and, the same day, the state legislature overrode his veto on another party-line vote. Our suit points out that the new map “is similar to the gerrymandered map that was the subject of universal abuse ten years ago as the worst gerrymander in the country.” The lawsuit details how the map distorts district lines, deviates from and crosses existing political boundaries, and fractures and divides communities of interest: Maryland’s Plan splits Anne Arundel County into three congressional districts. The middle of Anne Arundel County is ... connected to the Eastern Shore’s First Congressional District. The two areas are held together solely via the Chesapeake Bay Bridge.... Baltimore is divided among three congressional districts.... Montgomery County is divided among four congressional districts.... A roughly 20-mile trip north on the Baltimore-Washington Parkway from Cheverly, Maryland, a DC suburb, to Jessup, Maryland, an area outside [BWI] Airport, would cross congressional boundaries six times and lead a traveler through five different congressional districts. The lawsuit highlights how Maryland’s Fifth District features an “umbilical cord” designed to include Democratic voters in College Park to “counterbalance” the more Republican voters in the southern part of the state. And the Sixth Congressional District connects Garrett County, “the westernmost rural county which borders Pennsylvania and West Virginia,” with Potomac, Maryland, a wealthy DC suburb: As a federal court commented about the Sixth District in 2011, which made a similar linkage between these populations, it brings together voters “who have an interest in farming, mining, tourism, paper production, and the hunting of bears ... with voters who abhor the hunting of bears and do not know what a coal mine or paper mill even looks like.” These two groups have “different climate[s], root for different sports teams, and read different newspapers.” Outside experts agree that the plan is flawed, with the nonpartisan Princeton Gerrymandering Project giving it a grade of “F” for fairness and geographic compactness. In 2020, Republicans accounted for approximately 35% of Maryland’s Congressional votes, but they're unlikely to win even a single seat under this plan. This outcome wouldn't be possible without political gerrymandering. We argue that the plan violates Article 7 of the Maryland Declaration of Rights, which guarantees voters the right to “free and frequent” elections and the “right of suffrage.” Article 7 has been held to be “even more protective of rights of political participation than the provisions of the federal Constitution.” Additionally, the plan violates Article III, Section 4 of the Maryland Constitution, which provides that, “Each legislative district shall consist of adjoining territory, be compact in form, and of substantially equal population. Due regard shall be given to natural boundaries and the boundaries of political subdivisions.” Unfortunately, Democrats in the legislature went beyond politics to abuse of power in setting up Maryland’s gerrymandered congressional maps. This lawsuit seeks to protect the rights of all voters and citizens. Simply put: politicians shouldn’t get to pick their voters. | | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztui9hr91onmb48522hc38dt0pevjgcs1ob6fgg8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjim4o31c1h2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z996o1j098b3s1qrl7sau0qcv88pktcriomlvis8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjim4o31c1h2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcu3jin3o5nbljdmkbaueqeu0mfmeb3v95t4iaro_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjim4o31c1h2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z06hhu6ka9l6diacsr7bmnqrtqijag1da6siqqvg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjim4o31c1h2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjqgpar0ib2hvgr1peejo8rubnfud7mgtg9um2qo_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjim4o31c1h2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c8376%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=V12RGFsdVqPMvbpuzXjPpA&sysid=1)

This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. | | Hi, it’s Kelda, State Senator from Madison. I’m reaching out today to let you know why supporting Tom means supporting a better future for all of Wisconsin.

He has continued since the Parkland shooting to politicize any efforts to reduce gun violence. I will do anything I can to ensure Marco Rubio is no longer in the Senate, because we need an advocate like Val Demings, whose strength and integrity is exactly what Florida needs, to replace him. = Each and every day during her service in Congress – especially after the mass shootings in Parkland and at Pulse nightclub in her Orlando-based district – Val Demings has been one of the strongest fighters for gun safety reform. I'm reaching out asking you for dollars to meet this goal, but it's about the people we can save. It's about creating a gun safety majority in the Senate that will enact the urgent change our country needs – change to prevent families like mine from going through any more senseless tragedy. But incompetent Marco Rubio is backed by the nearly $30 million campaign war chest of the Senate Republicans. In fact, NRA-loving Republicans have already funneled tens of millions of dollars into Florida to defend Rubio. Val Demings can only win with the grassroots support of people like you and me, which is why I'm personally reaching out. I told the congresswoman I'd help raise $20,000 today for her Senate race – a race that experts are saying could decide Senate control. = I can never get my Jaime back, but helping changemakers like Val Demings – a leader who has passed lifesaving gun safety legislation – gives me the purpose I've needed since her murder. Thank you for doing your part to help. Fred Guttenberg Gun Violence Survivor Jaime and Jesse's dad | | = | | = Val Demings here: I can’t thank you enough for fighting alongside me to flip Florida blue. Florida will determine whether Democrats keep our Senate majority – that’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race to crush our movement and keep Florida red permanently. Our grassroots campaign is off to a great start, but in a race as close as this one, I need your help to surge ahead and defend the Senate. I’m relying on grassroots supporters like you, donating to emails like this, to help me defeat Marco Rubio and stop Mitch McConnell from flipping the Senate. Will you donate today to help me flip Florida blue? = If you’d like to purchase merchandise to show your support for this campaign, Thank you for your continued support. Together we’re going to protect voting rights, expand access to affordable health care and fully recover from this pandemic.

name: Geoff Diehl
subject: Reminder: We need to stop giving people so many reasons to move out of our state.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Diehl for Massachusetts
body:
Please support my campaign to make Massachusetts a better place to live!
| | | |
---
---
---
|
---
Dear Friend,
The latest population figures are in, and unfortunately the results aren't good for our state.
Massachusetts lost population in 2021. In fact, our state was fourth overall for the number of people we lost, just behind much bigger states of New York, California, and Illinois. Percentage-wise, Massachusetts ranked seventh for population decline.
---
---
Even though some of this loss is sadly attributable to the pandemic, it's clear the big reason for our state's decline is that people chose to move away from Massachusetts last year.
We know why. Despite the many wonderful reasons to live in Massachusetts, Beacon Hill leaders keep implementing policies that drive people away.
Massachusetts residents are flocking away from vaccine and mask mandates and seeking refuge in states like Florida, where their rights are respected. Bay Staters are moving away from high taxes here and protecting their nest egg by moving to New Hampshire. Businesses that find it tough to survive are picking up stakes and relocating elsewhere. Parents are frustrated by schools that don't give them a say in their kids' education.
When government takes away peoples' rights, their money, and their freedom, it's a self-fulfilling prophecy. People move away.
Fortunately, it doesn't have to be this way. We can do better!
My campaign is aimed at making Massachusetts a better place to live. As your next Governor, I will stand up against policies that drive people and businesses away from our state.
I'll fight against mandates that take away your freedom and taxes that take away your money. I'll make it easier for businesses to compete and grow jobs here. And, I'll respect your right to make education decisions for your children.
It's time to reverse the trend. Let's make Massachusetts a place where people want to stay and thrive. KathyJo and I chose to make Massachusetts our home because we love living here, and I want our next generation to feel the same way about our state.
---
We can do it. But, I need your help to accomplish all of our goals.
Will you please help me as I work to get the message out and stand up against policies that take away your rights and prosperity? If you are able to, please consider making a donation today:

| We deserve better, and I believe that we can do better. Friend, I want to say up top: This is going to be a bit of a longer email that ends with me asking you to [**chip in before our fundraising deadline tonight.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40228701/323396027/1205227003?refcode=em_20211231-fr-JD-eoy6-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNDcyYjA1NC00YTZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3JFIZwl-3ZOVDgCTU_sw8f2IDL8JeLeA9nIhpv5-Xto=) But I thought it was important to let you know where my head’s been at recently. When I first decided to run to represent the people of the Pittsburgh region, I knew it wouldn’t be an easy road. And the race has changed over time—with the incumbent retiring and new opponents entering. **But throughout it all, so many people in this community have stuck by me and shown support, and that truly means everything.** I mean, I’m a foster kid who grew up in a multi-racial family. Statistically speaking, I shouldn’t be where I am today: A former D1 soccer player. A tenured constitutional law professor. A candidate for Congress. It’s because of the support of this community and love of my adoptive parents that I beat the odds—and I can’t thank you all enough. When I reflect on how far I’ve come, I can’t help but think about the foster siblings I grew up with and how similar our paths were in the beginning. Addiction got the best of my brother Jamal, and he’s struggled for 20 years with sobriety. My brother Irish has only spent about 21 months of his adult life free—he’s currently serving a life sentence in prison. Four years ago, police called me to tell me that my brother Chuck overdosed on fentanyl in downtown Pittsburgh. All of them got trapped in a system that leaves too many people behind. Thinking about them reminds me of why I got into this race. Because the truth is, I’m not that much different than my siblings. I’ve been assaulted by the police. I’ve spent a night or two in a county jail. But somehow, I got lucky and I made it through. Now, I see it as my duty to make this world a better and more equitable place for kids like myself and my siblings. No one should have to fight tooth and nail just to scrape by. No one should go into debt to afford the medical care they need. No one should go without access to clean air and water in this country. No one should have to live in fear that a cop will shoot them because that cop was threatened by the color of their skin. **We deserve better, and I believe that we can do better.** We just need leaders who are willing to fight for us—and that’s why I’m running for Congress, friend. But I can’t do it without you. [**So if you’re tired of the same old politicians and the same old political fights and you’re looking for something different, then please, make a donation to my campaign before our big fundraising deadline tonight. It would really mean a lot to me.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40228703/323396028/1205227003?refcode=em_20211231-fr-JD-eoy6-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNDcyYjA1NC00YTZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3JFIZwl-3ZOVDgCTU_sw8f2IDL8JeLeA9nIhpv5-Xto=) Thanks, and cheers to 2022, Jerry

body:
| Peter,

The end-of-year deadline is tonight at midnight, and I'm writing you today to tell you why this matters.

**This is the very first time our fundraising numbers will be published by the FEC for everyone to see, meaning the pressure is on to build up as much support as possible before the ball drops.**

I know, you're probably receiving a lot of appeals asking for support, and that you likely have plenty of other things like your New Year's plans on your mind. But my campaign is completely people-powered, and I can't do this without you.

**So please, will you contribute to my campaign before the FEC deadline tonight?[_Click here to donate._](https://act.myngp.com/el/b3oZDMcL-giRuZqyeXkL4EmCCJvBEo9EQ0DcITmMovg=/1nSdhQj91bv4yhoKG72ZULeh_z6inRC6lRQOU98gOtc=?refcode=BLU-VFC-20211231-1-EM)**

When I first decided to run for office -- initially for school board -- it was because I thought I could bring something to the table to make people's lives better. That same motivation drove me to run for the North Carolina state House and state Senate. And now, as I run for Congress, it is for the exact same reason -- I have faith that I can lead in a way that makes the lives of people in my community better.

But running for Congress requires more resources than any of the offices I've run for before. We need to raise enough to compete in every part of this district and show the North Carolinians in my community that I'll fight tirelessly for them.

**This is my final request of 2021 -- please, Peter, will you contribute to my campaign before the end-of-year deadline? [_Click here to donate._](https://act.myngp.com/el/b3oZDMcL-giRuZqyeXkL4EmCCJvBEo9EQ0DcITmMovg=/1nSdhQj91bv4yhoKG72ZULeh_z6inRC6lRQOU98gOtc=?refcode=BLU-VFC-20211231-1-EM)**

My appreciation is plentiful. Have a happy and safe New Year's Eve and a joyful start to 2022.

All the best,

Valerie Foushee

Friends, The majority of families in district 46 rent their home — more than _any_ surrounding district. Over 100,000 households in our district, or nearly 1 in 3 of our neighbors, are severely rent burdened. We need to create a fair federal rent control program while expanding benefits for low-income housing. [**This is one of many promises Mike vows to hold on to and stay accountable for when he’s elected into office. Your $10 or $25 contribution will help our campaign close out the year on a strong note >>**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40230617/323401533/938621104?refcode=fl_email_fr_20211230housingrights_TO_full_xx_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTExMTNiYy00YjZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=mkHLVC7Jiifu-EoN9_doCaR4ljuNJNIrgV3lkenTFGA=) Living with that kind of anxiety and stress takes an incredible toll. clean_body: | = Friends, The majority of families in district 46 rent their home — more than any surrounding district. Over 100,000 households in our district, or nearly 1 in 3 of our neighbors, are severely rent burdened. We need to create a fair federal rent control program while expanding benefits for low-income housing. = Living with that kind of anxiety and stress takes an incredible toll. Housing is a human right. No one should have to worry about losing the roof over their head because of an unexpected expense like a surprise car repair or a doctor’s office visit. In fact, millions of Americans today are only one paycheck away from missing their rent payment. This is unacceptable. Lou Correa is a former real estate broker and millionaire whose wealth came from trusts. His campaign is funded by Big Pharma, real estate PACs and other corporate donors. We can’t trust Lou to think about the families in district 46 while he’s busy cozying up to the National Association of Realtors. name: Heidi St. John
subject: Deadline is at midnight
body:
Dear Peter,

This is it for 2021!

Tonight at midnight is the deadline to reach
the $50,000 fundraising goal my campaign team set just three
weeks ago.

As of right now, we've raised $47,322.48 from
more than 2,000 supporters across all 50 states!

This is truly a team effort . . . we're
almost there!

If you haven't yet done so, please chip in at
least $17.76 to help reach our goal!

When I set out to run for Congress a number
of months back, I knew it wasn't going to be easy. I'd always
heard the mudslinging and heated talk would be intense.

I can tell you that it has.

But during that time, I've also seen and
experienced the selflessness that comes from those who volunteer
their time and give of their generous resources for values and
principles they believe in.

I will forever be grateful for those
individuals. And also those who pray for me and my team, or just
give a thumbs up on Facebook.

The beauty of our campaign is that it truly
is funded by the grassroots, not big corporate interests and
lobbyists in Washington, DC. Sure, some people give the maximum
they're allowed to give, but most of our support is coming in
from contributions under $100.

I actually prefer it that way. I'm comforted
in knowing that our grassroots team is in the thousands!

The resources raised will go to things like
printing mailers, ordering campaign signs, and running ads on
radio, tv, and social media.

Thanks again for your prayers, volunteer
time, and generous support!

Chip in $17.76 by click HERE!

Happy New Year,

Heidi St. John
Republican for Congress
www.HeidiStJohnForCongress.com

body:
Where do I begin?

| | | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/40238507/323432623/1300596418?211231_cltv_eoythankyou_logo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5Mzc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk5MGM1YTUyLTU3NmEtZWMxMS05NGY2LTAwMDNmZmM1ODU3ZSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fCmQO5b7Yw0EMrbjvSAmDsCowKDXQLxaBKeXYsxPVKQ=)
---
Dear Peter,

Eden here. You don’t hear from me often, but when I have something I have to get off my chest, I put pen to paper.

This is hard to write about. I’m still figuring out how to tell this story.

Where do I begin?

Amidst the hellscape that was January 2021, friends and campaign professionals and government side workers began to debrief and process the 2020 election cycle.

It was a really hard, terrible, confusing time for everyone. We talked about how there were some huge, huge problems in this country that we, as individuals, simply could not control. We talked about leaving the industry. But none of us really wanted to leave. We wanted to stick around and fight, but for what? Where should we focus our efforts? That was the question at hand.

We started to think about what we don’t like about this industry-- and this country -- and where we, as individuals, could possibly make an impact.

We kept turning back the to broken pipeline that exists in Democratic politics, especially the huge financial barriers that make it hard for working-class and poor staff and candidates to get their foot in the door. For example: To be a campaign professional, it is expected that staff own a car to drive across the district— _without reimbursement for wear and tear put on the vehicle, and often without guaranteed reimbursement for mileage._

Staff are expected to have a high quality phone and laptop to do their work effectively. _Staff are expected to move across the country on their own dime._

And candidates suffer from similar requirements: having access to personal funds to start up the campaign, _having the privilege to quit their day jobs in order to campaign full time_ , the list goes on.

I **can't stand by** as Marylanders get boxed out of opportunities and too many of our kids live in poverty.

I **will not accept** that opportunity is only available to certain Marylanders to succeed and create wealth to leave behind for the next generation.

clean_body: | Friends, Before the year ends, I want to take a few moments to make sure you know how grateful I am for your support. Since day one, I have refused to accept a single donation from corporate PACs because I want to build a campaign you’re proud to be part of. I want our movement to be of, by, and for the good people of Texas. I want to build a diverse, strong, and vibrant coalition of supporters from every single county to take on Dan Patrick, the GOP establishment, and the political corruption plaguing the Lieutenant Governor’s office. We’re running a people-powered campaign to put power back in the hands of Texans. And trust me, we could not do any of this without you (nor would we want to!). But I need to be frank with you. Experts are saying this will be one of the closest and most expensive state races in the country. And the problem is, my opponent is bankrolled by almost every corporate special interest under the sun. But the way I see it, Dan Patrick can have all the cash in the world, but there is something much more important that they don’t have — you. I’m confident that with support from people like you we can build the kind of campaign it will take to win and defeat Dan Patrick once and for all. We’ve been pointing to our Texas Ethics Commission filing deadline all week because I’ve always believed that our honest-to-God, best shot at winning this race is if as many folks like you as possible give what they can to make a meaningful difference. So, I’m personally asking: = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Your support is the reason we will win this race for the people of our beloved Texas. Thanks for all you’ve done to make our campaign so successful. I mean it. Have a terrific New Year and I’ll see y’all in 2022! — Mike The Collier Committee P.O. body:
Peter,

As we prepare to take a break from [_**supporting and electing veterans and military family candidates of integrity for Congress**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/Sco5MLlAY5jwNfJAxo3OpsBSqWPdqOpSggEhJNeYFR8=/khWCyQwFdr43vC690PbrDevHjmsXF7M6SKczkS5tk4I=) for the New Year holiday, I want to tell you how incredibly grateful we are for you.

One of my favorite movies of all time is Frank Capra's "It's a Wonderful Life" (and not just because it was filmed down the road from me in Upstate New York).

As the omicron variant drives up COVID cases across the country, it's easy to feel depressed and alone. But the truth is that none of us is alone. Much like George Bailey's Bedford Falls, part of the power of Taking the Hill is that we are there for each other. When one of us is down or needs help, we rally to their side.

_And, if you 're reading this email, you are part of our community and we will be there for you._

So no matter where this email finds you - even if you're in quarantine with your kids, like me - I hope you know that we are all here together, for each other. And, as Clarence reminded George Bailey:

**_"_No_ one is a failure who has _friends._ "_**

Happy New Year! (And if you can spare it, [_**we are still trying to raise $1,118 before midnight to reach our last goal for 2021.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/Sco5MLlAY5jwNfJAxo3OpsBSqWPdqOpSggEhJNeYFR8=/khWCyQwFdr43vC690PbrDevHjmsXF7M6SKczkS5tk4I=))

Yours in service,
Roger

Happy New Year, Peter!

We wanted to be among the first to wish you and those you love a happy and healthy new year! Every January brings us a moment to reflect on the past year and look to the future. 2021 has had its challenges, but it’s clear that we have created momentum that we’re excited to build upon in 2022.

2021 has been a year of change. We finally have a Democratic President in the White House, and I’m wrapping up my first year as Chair of the Tennessee Democratic Party. Throughout this year, we brought on a new and talented team to run the Party and built relationships with Tennessee organizers and voters to last for years to come. More specifically, we made first steps in running a remarkable election year program for 2022 that expects to not only flip more districts but also register thousands of new voters.

The challenges have been real, but we have pushed through, persevered, and accomplished so much. I’m so proud of you and what we’re building here. Thanks to your support, we will be starting 2022 stronger than ever, with a party infrastructure that’s prepared to take on our opposition. We’re ready to Build Back Blue.

This upcoming year is filled with possibilities, especially with you as a Tennessee Democrat. Together, we have the power to go forward boldly — for our community, for Tennessee, and for our country.
We are the leaders now — it’s up to us to build the Tennessee we know is possible, leaving no member of our community behind. Thank you again for being the backbone of our success.

Onward to a promising 2022, Happy New Year!

Hendrell Remus
he/him
Chair, Tennessee Democratic Party

body:
Happy New Year! | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/schulzforohio/end-of-2021-message?e=cecfea7090)
---
| | |
---
|
---
| | |
# Dear Friends,

As 2021 comes to a close, I want us all to look back with understanding and look forward with determination, courage and faith. My year began similarly to countless millions of Americans as we faced down the reality of a Joe Biden presidency while still reeling from the rigged 2020 election. We saw ballot harvesting, shady late-night tabulations and votes being counted that would have never been accepted in any other election in American history. Like you, I was unsure how we should proceed. We had just lived through a year where Democrats, RINO Republicans and authoritarian public health departments told American citizens that we could not go to work, could not go to church, had to shutter our private business and, at times, we were told we could not even leave our homes. We were called “nonessential” and were taught to treat our neighbors as a walking disease ready to strike. After all of this, we were facing down the most radical administration in American history who promised to defund the police, mandate vaccines and launch an assault on our Second Amendment rights. To top it all off, January 6th was used as an excuse to weaponize the FBI to hunt down and jail political prisoners who have yet to be released on simple charges of trespassing nearly one year later.

Many of us then realized that the responsibility to save America was on our shoulders and that there was no one coming to rescue us. Then, on January 13th, ten House “Republicans” joined the Democrats in the sham impeachment of President Donald Trump. This vote took place with no evidence or due process in direct violation of our Constitution. So much of what would have been considered unthinkable just two short years ago had happened. It had become clear that our elite political class was a failure. Our only path forward was to defeat the establishment in DC, Columbus and from coast to coast. Three weeks later, I launched my primary challenge to Anthony Gonzalez.

Enthusiastically backing impeachment, amnesty, rampant spending and lockdown/masking mandates, Gonzalez was the perfect example of phony Republicans who are taking us down the same road as the radical left. We can no longer allow the Mitt Romneys and Liz Cheneys of the world to steer our party further and further to the left. But as I’ve said from the beginning, Anthony Gonzalez is not the problem, he is merely a symptom of the much bigger issue – that more than a republic, more than a democracy, we are increasingly living in an oligarchy where only the wealthy “elite” have access to the levers of power. We The People have forfeited our political power to the privileged few who consistently come from the same families, the same donors and same country club circles. We have failed to elect political outsiders who know what it means to live and work in our communities. That is why I launched this campaign – to end the political cycle that puts in place crooked politicians and RINOs. Nearly 11 months since my announcement, we are on the path to victory.

In 2021, I attended over 200 events, our team knocked over 25,000 doors and we distributed more than 700 yard signs with still 4 months to go before the Republican primary election. I have been blessed with an incredible team – a campaign director who works around the clock, county coordinators who live and breathe liberty and volunteers who have dedicated their time, talent and treasure to our movement.

It has been a tumultuous year as we have skyrocketing inflation, rampant crime, product/worker shortages and unconstitutional decrees that have mandated medical discrimination and segregation. Despite this, the words of John Adams in 1776 echo in my head: “Through the thick gloom of the present, I see the brightness of the future as the sun in heaven.” We are living in darkness and chaos, that is beyond dispute. But I would encourage you to believe that you have been placed here for a purpose. We are the people who have been placed here by God to save America. You could have been born in any other place at any other time, but you weren’t. You were placed right here, right now, for a purpose. How few people in all of human history have even had the opportunity to fight for their freedom? We are just a small fraction to have that chance. Do not let it go to waste.

I want to express a heartfelt thank you to every one of you who have supported my campaign. You, the Patriots of this great nation, continue to provide me with courage and hope. I do not know what 2022 will hold for us, but I know that I will continue to fight until every man and woman in America is free to dictate their own life and destiny.

_God Bless and Happy New Year,_

clean_body: Happy New Year! | | | | | | | | | | | Dear Friends, As 2021 comes to a close, I want us all to look back with understanding and look forward with determination, courage and faith. My year began similarly to countless millions of Americans as we faced down the reality of a Joe Biden presidency while still reeling from the rigged 2020 election. We saw ballot harvesting, shady late-night tabulations and votes being counted that would have never been accepted in any other election in American history. Like you, I was unsure how we should proceed. We had just lived through a year where Democrats, RINO Republicans and authoritarian public health departments told American citizens that we could not go to work, could not go to church, had to shutter our private business and, at times, we were told we could not even leave our homes. We were called “nonessential” and were taught to treat our neighbors as a walking disease ready to strike. After all of this, we were facing down the most radical administration in American history who promised to defund the police, mandate vaccines and launch an assault on our Second Amendment rights. To top it all off, January 6th was used as an excuse to weaponize the FBI to hunt down and jail political prisoners who have yet to be released on simple charges of trespassing nearly one year later. Many of us then realized that the responsibility to save America was on our shoulders and that there was no one coming to rescue us. Then, on January 13th, ten House “Republicans” joined the Democrats in the sham impeachment of President Donald Trump. This vote took place with no evidence or due process in direct violation of our Constitution. So much of what would have been considered unthinkable just two short years ago had happened. It had become clear that our elite political class was a failure. Our only path forward was to defeat the establishment in DC, Columbus and from coast to coast. Three weeks later, I launched my primary challenge to Anthony Gonzalez. Enthusiastically backing impeachment, amnesty, rampant spending and lockdown/masking mandates, Gonzalez was the perfect example of phony Republicans who are taking us down the same road as the radical left. We can no longer allow the Mitt Romneys and Liz Cheneys of the world to steer our party further and further to the left. But as I’ve said from the beginning, Anthony Gonzalez is not the problem, he is merely a symptom of the much bigger issue – that more than a republic, more than a democracy, we are increasingly living in an oligarchy where only the wealthy “elite” have access to the levers of power. We The People have forfeited our political power to the privileged few who consistently come from the same families, the same donors and same country club circles. We have failed to elect political outsiders who know what it means to live and work in our communities. That is why I launched this campaign – to end the political cycle that puts in place crooked politicians and RINOs. Nearly 11 months since my announcement, we are on the path to victory. In 2021, I attended over 200 events, our team knocked over 25,000 doors and we distributed more than 700 yard signs with still 4 months to go before the Republican primary election. I have been blessed with an incredible team – a campaign director who works around the clock, county coordinators who live and breathe liberty and volunteers who have dedicated their time, talent and treasure to our movement. It has been a tumultuous year as we have skyrocketing inflation, rampant crime, product/worker shortages and unconstitutional decrees that have mandated medical discrimination and segregation. Despite this, the words of John Adams in 1776 echo in my head: “Through the thick gloom of the present, I see the brightness of the future as the sun in heaven.” We are living in darkness and chaos, that is beyond dispute. But I would encourage you to believe that you have been placed here for a purpose. We are the people who have been placed here by God to save America. You could have been born in any other place at any other time, but you weren’t. You were placed right here, right now, for a purpose. How few people in all of human history have even had the opportunity to fight for their freedom? We are just a small fraction to have that chance. Do not let it go to waste. I want to express a heartfelt thank you to every one of you who have supported my campaign. You, the Patriots of this great nation, continue to provide me with courage and hope. I do not know what 2022 will hold for us, but I know that I will continue to fight until every man and woman in America is free to dictate their own life and destiny. God Bless and Happy New Year, | | Jonah Schulz | | | "SchulzForCongress.com" | | | | | | | | | Paid for by Schulz for Ohio | Copyright © 2021 Schulz For Ohio, All rights reserved.

My Sisters and Brothers,

2021 has flown by! We’ve worked through an unprecedented year with some new lows, but more importantly, many new high points for our nation.

While we take a moment to ring in 2022 in just a few hours, make no mistake about it: this is not the time to rest! This is the time to get to work! Trump and his GOP sheep are working 24/7 to further restrict your voice and your constitutional right to vote. Trump’s Republican Party has made it crystal clear that they do not respect the Constitution or their sworn oath to protect and abide by it.

I know so many of you are exhausted – from the health pandemic to the January 6th insurrection to anxiety about the challenges in front of us. Let me share a little secret with you: Republicans know how powerful we are! We showed them our strength in November 2018 and 2020. Now they’re basing their entire 2022 strategy on the idea that Democrats are tired.

We are NOT tired! We are ready to rise up once again and show the world what it means when Democrats represent! I’ve got my victory face on, my friends, and I need to know you’re ready to rise with me and put our power into action in 2022! Are you with ready!?

You are the wind beneath my wings, and I need you to know that I am here to do the same for you. We resisted. We rose. And now we must continue to prove our power and represent together!

2022 – here we come!!! Together, #WeRepresent

-Gwen Moore

| | **\- INDems to Gov. Holcomb: Stand Up to Your Own Party -** On Wednesday, the Indiana Democratic Party called on Governor Eric Holcomb to condemn the Indiana Republican Party’s effort to discredit the COVID-19 vaccine during his first (public) pandemic address in more than 274 days. The INGOP’s partisan effort includes House Bill 1001 and Senate Bill 114, proposed legislation which would further taint the life-saving vaccine, force businesses to pay for critical COVID testing, and keep the state as the most dangerous place to live during the pandemic. GOP House Speaker Todd Huston views anti-vaccine House Bill 1001 as a “top priority” for the 2022 legislative session, and Indiana Republicans are ready to ignore opposition by the Indiana Chamber of Commerce and health experts to get it signed into law. This partisan strategy continues the INGOP’s year-long attack on the vaccine which has led to abysmal state vaccination rates and more empty chairs at dinner tables across the Hoosier State. Holcomb must publicly oppose this partisan and dangerous legislation as well as leaders who work overtime to discredit the pandemic altogether. That includes Attorney General Todd Rokita, who told South Bend’s WSBT in an interview earlier this week that he doesn’t believe the COVID numbers released by the state. **With Indiana’s hospitals reaching capacity levels not seen during the entire pandemic, Democrats call on Governor Holcomb to stop his own party’s partisan attempts to discredit the vaccine and fight against COVID - because it’s literally killing Hoosiers. **
**\- American Rescue Plan’s READI Delivers for Indiana -** This month, Hoosiers learned about the brighter future President Joe Biden’s American Rescue Plan is creating for them. This time, the Rescue Plan’s READI program – a $500 million economic development effort commissioned by the state – is providing key investments in all corners of Indiana. This program has been described by Indiana Republicans as an “anchor” for the state’s future success. Had it not been for Indiana Democrats who voted for the Rescue Plan, the READI program would not have been possible. body:
Dear Peter, By now you're likely being inundated with requests from candidates to donate to campaigns. As a candidate, one of the things that's used to measure campaigns is fundraising and donations. _How many donors? How much raised?_ Sometimes, the best measure is _**who**_ donates and _**why**_. **Over the holidays, I received a donation from a group of four individuals who on the surface seemed unlikely to support me. Conservative in their viewpoints, they looked at my website and found they believed in my ideals, values and work ethic. They gave what they could and I was notified with a card.** That gesture is what this race is about—talking to all residents of this district and listening to them. Listening to what their needs and expectations are for their Congressperson. Someone they expect to be present, to show up, to represent them. That's what we've been missing for almost 10 years under Ann Wagner's wasted time in office. I want to ask if you will help support our efforts as we embark on a bold field operation to have these conversations across the 2nd District. The more people we talk to, the more likely we'll persuade them that there is something, and someone, much better on the horizon. **Just like those four conservative donors, they realized there's a better way and stepped up to fight for it**. body:
John Cranley for Governor

Hey folks,

I know we’ve been asking for your support a lot over the last few days, but our major fundraising deadline is now less than 12 hours away, so I promise this is the last time our campaign will reach out this year.

To cut right to the chase, I need you to chip in $25 — or whatever’s right for you — before our end-of-year deadline at midnight, so don’t wait to click. I had our finance team put together a personal donation link for you: secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec21eoy?refcode=OnlineSupporter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec21eoy&amount=25]

The fact is, what we raise tonight has a bearing on our momentum next year. After our numbers go public, everyone will be comparing our campaign’s strength to our opponents — we CAN’T afford to fall short.

If you’re with me in the fight to protect voting rights, to legalize marijuana, to advance renewable energy, and to turn this state around, there’s truly no better time for you to show your support.

Tonight — right now — is the moment when you can make the greatest impact on our campaign’s success. Please, chip in whatever you can before midnight.

Here’s that link one last time, and thanks so much for all your support this year: secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec21eoy?refcode=OnlineSupporter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec21eoy&amount=25]

name: Patrick Leahy
subject: Hamstrung
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Leahy for U
body:
Friend –

The Cook Political Report has rated three Senate Democrats running for reelection as vulnerable "toss ups."

Senators Mark Kelly (AZ), Raphael Warnock (GA), and Catherine Cortez Masto (NV) are each in tight races against multiple GOP challengers. Losing even one of their seats to a Republican could shatter any chance we have to continue making progress for the American people. Losing all of them would be devastating beyond measure.

To be frank, these incumbents are depending on supporters like you and me to make sure they finish the year strong. We need to make sure their campaigns start off 2022 with end-of-year fundraising reports that show just how many Americans are behind them.

Before their campaigns' official end-of-year fundraising deadline on Friday at midnight, will you make a donation right now to be split between Senators Kelly, Warnock, and Cortez Masto?
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.

I am proud to work alongside all three of these senators as we show up to work to deliver progress for the American people:

Senator Mark Kelly was instrumental in getting the bipartisan infrastructure bill passed and consistently bringing leadership centered on science, data, and facts to Congress. We must keep him in the Senate.

There are few voices clearer than Senator Raphael Warnock's when it comes to protecting the right to vote for all Americans. To protect our democracy, we must keep him right where he is.

Senator Cortez Masto has served alongside me since 2017, and I've been consistently impressed by her advocacy on behalf of working families, in her home state of Nevada and across the country. We can't afford for Republicans to turn her seat red, though I can tell you for certain that they're spending a lot of money trying.

Throwing our support to these three candidates now will make a significant difference in the new year. Let's keep these vulnerable incumbents in office, so we can expand our Democratic majority together.

Before their campaigns' end-of-year fundraising deadline on Friday at midnight, will you make a contribution right now to be split between these three campaigns?
https://links.e.leahyforvermont.

Thank you for your support -- and wishing you and your family a very happy New Year.

Sincerely,

Patrick Leahy
U.S. Senator

name: Derek Kilmer
subject: Renewed hope
disclaimer_text: Paid for by People for Derek Kilmer
body:
Happy New Year's Eve, Peter!

2021 has been a challenging year, but it's also been a year full of hope. While we've fought the COVID-19 pandemic, the vaccines have given us a renewed hope that we can end this pandemic. And while we witnessed a horrific insurrection at the start of 2021, our democracy has prevailed.

President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris are leading the fight to rebuild a stronger country for everyone, and we've made critical progress in Congress this past year. We passed legislation from the House to provide COVID-19 relief, invest in our infrastructure, Build Back Better, protect voting rights, safeguard our democracy, fight for equality and justice, and so much more. While some of these important bills have become law, we need to keep fighting to get the other ones across the finish line too.

The progress we've made is important, but we still have so much work ahead of us. I know together, we can protect our House majority in the new year and keep moving our country forward.

I'm so grateful to be able to serve you in Congress every day. And in 2022, I will keep working to make progress for you. I will wake up every morning working to make our economy - and our Congress - work better for the American people.

[**I can 't wait to see what we accomplish together in the New Year, Peter. If you're with me in the work ahead to build a stronger nation for all of us, will you chip in whatever you can before our final end-of-year deadline tonight at midnight?**](https://act.myngp.com/el/eMB_ci13sJkC-Hya9vClf-PqujfARaMYCGH88QnehF8=/8dXMsi0Ly66g28aDDEN8VE9BJO7HpQCtTeFy_hMu5wk=?refcode=em21_211231_EOY3_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em21_211231_EOY3_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email)
