subject: Joe Biden’s Top 25 Worst Moments of 2021
body:
President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. -- President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. Here are the top 25 worst moments from 2021: 25. Joe Biden Rips Coast Guard Graduates During Commencement Speech In May 2021, Biden ridiculed Coast Guard graduates after they did not react to a line in his commencement speech that he wanted to elicit applause. “Why you’re a real dull class. I mean, c’mon man, is the sun getting to you? I would think you’d have an opportunity when I say that about the Navy to clap,” Biden said, appearing irritated. The White House / YouTube 24. Joe Biden Calls Australian PM ‘That Fella Down Under’ President Biden appeared to forget who he was talking to when he called Australia’s Prime Minister Scott Morrison “that fella down under.” “Thank you Boris and I want to thank uh… that fella Down Under,” Biden said, as he spoke with UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and Morrison during a video conference call. Scott Morrison, Tracey Nearmy/Getty Images   23. Joe Biden Loses Mask at Outdoor Event  In April, Biden lost his mask at an outdoor campaign event with Democrat Sens. Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff, stumbling and interrupting the event as he searched for it. “I’m looking for my mask. I’m in trouble,” Biden apologized to the crowd. Throughout 2021, Biden struggled with masking protocols as he repeatedly lectured critics of mask mandates as being unpatriotic. At times he appeared publicly with his mask, at other times he walked away from events without his mask and greeted the public. During a video climate summit call with world leaders, Biden was the only one at one point wearing a mask on camera. WARREN, MICHIGAN – SEPTEMBER 09: Democratic presidential nominee and former Vice President Joe Biden replaces the mask he wears to reduce the risk posed by coronavirus after addressing union members outside the United Auto Workers Region 1 offices on September 09, 2020 in Warren, Michigan. Biden is campaigning in Michigan, a state President Donald Trump won in 2016 by less than 11,000 votes, the narrowest margin of victory in state’s presidential election history. (Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)   22. Joe Biden reverses reaction on Kyle Rittenhouse verdict In November 2021, President Joe Biden reacted to the verdict in the Kyle Rittenhouse trial by standing by the jury’s decision. “I stand by what the jury has to say,” Biden said shortly. “The jury system works and we have to abide by it.” Just hours later, the White House released a statement from Biden that said he was “angry and concerned” by the verdict, suggesting the jury’s decision was the wrong one. In this Oct. 21, 2021, file photo, President Joe Biden participates in a CNN town hall at the Baltimore Center Stage Pearlstone Theater, in Baltimore. North Korea on Saturday, Oct. 23, accused the Biden administration of raising military tensions with China with its “reckless” backing of Taiwan and claimed that the growing U.S. military presence in the region poses a potential threat to the North. (AP Photo/Evan Vucci, File) Kyle Rittenhouse looks back at the gallery in the courtroom as the room is let go for an afternoon break at the Kenosha County Courthouse in Kenosha, Wis., on Monday, Nov. 1, 2021. Rittenhouse, an aspiring police officer, shot two people to death and wounded a third during a night of anti-racism protests in Kenosha last year. (Sean Krajacic/The Kenosha News via AP, Pool)   21. Joe Biden says “I Agree” After Dad Says “Let’s Go, Brandon!” In December 2021, Biden appeared unfamiliar with the “Let’s Go Brandon!” chant popularized among his critics to voice their dissent with his presidency. During a NORAD Santa tracker call with his children, Jared Schmeck, 35, said the phrase to Biden, prompting the president to repeat the phrase and say “Let’s go Brandon. I agree.” Let’s Go Brandon 20. Biden Supports Major League Baseball’s Decision to Pull All-Star Game from Atlanta  In April 2021, Biden voiced support for Major League Baseball’s decision to pull the All-Star game from Atlanta in protest of Georgia’s election security laws. “I think today’s professional athletes are acting incredibly responsibly. I would strongly support them doing that,” Biden said in an ESPN interview. “People look to them. They’re leaders.” The boycott  cost the state of Georgia and the city of Atlanta an estimated $100 million and hurt minority-owned businesses, making it so unpopular that even Stacey Abrams shifted her position on the boycott. 19. Joe Biden Diplomatic Disaster Angers France In September 2021, France recalled their ambassador to America for the first time in the long history between the two nations after Biden and his administration made a nuclear submarine deal with Australia that canceled an existing multi-billion dollar deal with France. The French first learned about the deal in the media, not from the Americans or the Australians. Biden later admitted his blunder during a visit with French President Emmanuel Macron. “I think what happened was, to use an English phrase, what we did was clumsy, not done with a lot of grace,” Biden said. “I was under the impression that certain things had happened that hadn’t happened.” Macron Head Down 18. Joe Biden Paralyzed by Colonial Pipeline Hack  In May 2021, President Biden was left helpless after cybercriminals in Russia hacked the Colonial Pipeline, disrupting fuel supplies on the East Coast. In response, Biden asked Americans not to panic and to limit their fuel purchases until the “hiccup” was over. The federal government watched as Colonial Pipeline paid about $5 million in ransom to foreign hackers to free the pipeline. 17. Joe Biden Clueless as He Marvels at $4.50 a Gallon Gas Prices  In November 2021, Biden marveled at the high cost of gas, without acknowledging his policies that were hurting domestic oil production. “Did you ever think you’d be paying this much for a gallon of gas?” Biden said. “In some parts of California, they’re paying $4.50 a gallon.” The high cost of gas was a persistent problem throughout 2021, as Biden and his administration failed to enact more regulatory relief and policies that would actually increase domestic oil production and lower prices. On day one of his presidency, Biden revoked a crucial permit for the Keystone XL pipeline, halting construction of the project.Biden also ordered a pause on all oil and gas leases on federal lands. A pedestrian walks past gas station fuel prices above $5 and $6 per gallon at Death Valley National Park in June 17, 2021 in Furnace Creek, California. – Much of the western United States is braced for record heat waves this week, with approximately 50 million Americans placed on alert Tuesday for “excessive” temperatures, which could approach 120 degrees Fahrenheit (50 degrees Celsius) in some areas. The National Park Service warns of extreme summer heat, urging tourists to carry extra water and “travel prepared to survive” in the hottest, lowest, and driest national park featuring steady drought and extreme climates. (Photo by Patrick T. FALLON / AFP) (Photo by PATRICK T. FALLON/AFP via Getty Images) 16. Joe Biden Denounces Transgender Sports Bans as ‘Un-American’ In June 2021, Biden decried efforts by Republicans to ban biological males from competing in female sports as transgender women and wiping out the competition. “These are some of the ugliest, most un-American bills I’ve seen and I’ve been here a long time,” Biden said during a gay and transgender pride reception at the White House. “Let’s be clear. This is no more than bullying disguised as legislation,” he added. 15. Joe Biden Voices Dissent with Catholic Teaching on Abortion In September 2021, Biden declared he did not agree with the Catholic Church’s teaching on abortion — despite purporting to be a “devout Catholic.” “I respect those who believe life begins at the moment of conception and all … I respect that. Don’t agree. But I respect that,” Biden said. The president continued to defy Catholic teaching, even claiming after visiting Pope Francis that the pontiff told him he was still a good Catholic and to keep receiving communion. The Vatican did not comment on Biden’s assertion, citing the private nature of the conversation. US President Joe Biden, left, talks to Pope Francis as they meet at the Vatican, Friday, Oct. 29, 2021. President Joe Biden met with Pope Francis on Friday at the Vatican, where the world’s two most notable Roman Catholics plan to discuss the COVID-19 pandemic, climate change and poverty. clean_body: President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. -- President Joe Biden spent his first year as president making one embarrassing mistake after another on issues important to Americans and while representing the United States. Here are the top 25 worst moments from 2021: 25. Joe Biden Rips Coast Guard Graduates During Commencement Speech In May 2021, Biden ridiculed Coast Guard graduates after they did not react to a line in his commencement speech that he wanted to elicit applause. “Why you’re a real dull class. I mean, c’mon man, is the sun getting to you? I would think you’d have an opportunity when I say that about the Navy to clap,” Biden said, appearing irritated. The White House / YouTube 24. Joe Biden Calls Australian PM ‘That Fella Down Under’ President Biden appeared to forget who he was talking to when he called Australia’s Prime Minister Scott Morrison “that fella down under.” “Thank you Boris and I want to thank uh… that fella Down Under,” Biden said, as he spoke with UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson and Morrison during a video conference call. Scott Morrison, Tracey Nearmy/Getty Images   23. Joe Biden Loses Mask at Outdoor Event  In April, Biden lost his mask at an outdoor campaign event with Democrat Sens. Raphael Warnock and Jon Ossoff, stumbling and interrupting the event as he searched for it. “I’m looking for my mask. I’m in trouble,” Biden apologized to the crowd. Throughout 2021, Biden struggled with masking protocols as he repeatedly lectured critics of mask mandates as being unpatriotic. At times he appeared publicly with his mask, at other times he walked away from events without his mask and greeted the public. During a video climate summit call with world leaders, Biden was the only one at one point wearing a mask on camera. WARREN, MICHIGAN – SEPTEMBER 09: Democratic presidential nominee and former Vice President Joe Biden replaces the mask he wears to reduce the risk posed by coronavirus after addressing union members outside the United Auto Workers Region 1 offices on September 09, 2020 in Warren, Michigan. Biden is campaigning in Michigan, a state President Donald Trump won in 2016 by less than 11,000 votes, the narrowest margin of victory in state’s presidential election history. (Photo by Chip Somodevilla/Getty Images)   22. Joe Biden reverses reaction on Kyle Rittenhouse verdict In November 2021, President Joe Biden reacted to the verdict in the Kyle Rittenhouse trial by standing by the jury’s decision. “I stand by what the jury has to say,” Biden said shortly. “The jury system works and we have to abide by it.” Just hours later, the White House released a statement from Biden that said he was “angry and concerned” by the verdict, suggesting the jury’s decision was the wrong one. In this Oct. 21, 2021, file photo, President Joe Biden participates in a CNN town hall at the Baltimore Center Stage Pearlstone Theater, in Baltimore. North Korea on Saturday, Oct. 23, accused the Biden administration of raising military tensions with China with its “reckless” backing of Taiwan and claimed that the growing U.S. military presence in the region poses a potential threat to the North. (AP Photo/Evan Vucci, File) Kyle Rittenhouse looks back at the gallery in the courtroom as the room is let go for an afternoon break at the Kenosha County Courthouse in Kenosha, Wis., on Monday, Nov. 1, 2021. Rittenhouse, an aspiring police officer, shot two people to death and wounded a third during a night of anti-racism protests in Kenosha last year. (Sean Krajacic/The Kenosha News via AP, Pool)   21. Joe Biden says “I Agree” After Dad Says “Let’s Go, Brandon!” In December 2021, Biden appeared unfamiliar with the “Let’s Go Brandon!” chant popularized among his critics to voice their dissent with his presidency. During a NORAD Santa tracker call with his children, Jared Schmeck, 35, said the phrase to Biden, prompting the president to repeat the phrase and say “Let’s go Brandon. I agree.” Let’s Go Brandon 20. Biden Supports Major League Baseball’s Decision to Pull All-Star Game from Atlanta  In April 2021, Biden voiced support for Major League Baseball’s decision to pull the All-Star game from Atlanta in protest of Georgia’s election security laws. “I think today’s professional athletes are acting incredibly responsibly. I would strongly support them doing that,” Biden said in an ESPN interview. “People look to them. They’re leaders.” The boycott  cost the state of Georgia and the city of Atlanta an estimated $100 million and hurt minority-owned businesses, making it so unpopular that even Stacey Abrams shifted her position on the boycott. 19. Joe Biden Diplomatic Disaster Angers France In September 2021, France recalled their ambassador to America for the first time in the long history between the two nations after Biden and his administration made a nuclear submarine deal with Australia that canceled an existing multi-billion dollar deal with France. The French first learned about the deal in the media, not from the Americans or the Australians. Biden later admitted his blunder during a visit with French President Emmanuel Macron. “I think what happened was, to use an English phrase, what we did was clumsy, not done with a lot of grace,” Biden said. “I was under the impression that certain things had happened that hadn’t happened.” Macron Head Down 18. Joe Biden Paralyzed by Colonial Pipeline Hack  In May 2021, President Biden was left helpless after cybercriminals in Russia hacked the Colonial Pipeline, disrupting fuel supplies on the East Coast. In response, Biden asked Americans not to panic and to limit their fuel purchases until the “hiccup” was over. The federal government watched as Colonial Pipeline paid about $5 million in ransom to foreign hackers to free the pipeline. 17. Joe Biden Clueless as He Marvels at $4.50 a Gallon Gas Prices  In November 2021, Biden marveled at the high cost of gas, without acknowledging his policies that were hurting domestic oil production. “Did you ever think you’d be paying this much for a gallon of gas?” Biden said. “In some parts of California, they’re paying $4.50 a gallon.” The high cost of gas was a persistent problem throughout 2021, as Biden and his administration failed to enact more regulatory relief and policies that would actually increase domestic oil production and lower prices. On day one of his presidency, Biden revoked a crucial permit for the Keystone XL pipeline, halting construction of the project.Biden also ordered a pause on all oil and gas leases on federal lands. A pedestrian walks past gas station fuel prices above $5 and $6 per gallon at Death Valley National Park in June 17, 2021 in Furnace Creek, California. – Much of the western United States is braced for record heat waves this week, with approximately 50 million Americans placed on alert Tuesday for “excessive” temperatures, which could approach 120 degrees Fahrenheit (50 degrees Celsius) in some areas. The National Park Service warns of extreme summer heat, urging tourists to carry extra water and “travel prepared to survive” in the hottest, lowest, and driest national park featuring steady drought and extreme climates. (Photo by Patrick T. FALLON / AFP) (Photo by PATRICK T. FALLON/AFP via Getty Images) 16. Joe Biden Denounces Transgender Sports Bans as ‘Un-American’ In June 2021, Biden decried efforts by Republicans to ban biological males from competing in female sports as transgender women and wiping out the competition. “These are some of the ugliest, most un-American bills I’ve seen and I’ve been here a long time,” Biden said during a gay and transgender pride reception at the White House. “Let’s be clear. This is no more than bullying disguised as legislation,” he added. 15. Joe Biden Voices Dissent with Catholic Teaching on Abortion In September 2021, Biden declared he did not agree with the Catholic Church’s teaching on abortion — despite purporting to be a “devout Catholic.” “I respect those who believe life begins at the moment of conception and all … I respect that. Don’t agree. But I respect that,” Biden said. The president continued to defy Catholic teaching, even claiming after visiting Pope Francis that the pontiff told him he was still a good Catholic and to keep receiving communion. The Vatican did not comment on Biden’s assertion, citing the private nature of the conversation. US President Joe Biden, left, talks to Pope Francis as they meet at the Vatican, Friday, Oct. 29, 2021. President Joe Biden met with Pope Francis on Friday at the Vatican, where the world’s two most notable Roman Catholics plan to discuss the COVID-19 pandemic, climate change and poverty. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. Happy New Year's Eve — I hope you and your loved ones are safe and healthy. Bruce and I always like to have a quiet New Year's, so tonight, we'll keep up our tradition of rewatching Casablanca for the zillionth time. Every time I watch it, Casablanca gives me hope. It's a story about love, loyalty, and courage. It's about how people survive and how they flourish — even against all odds. And it's about hope — young people on the threshold of building a new life, and old people looking for a safe landing place. At the edge of a big transformation — praying and fighting for a brighter dawn. We can all use some more hope right now. 2022 will be a better year, but not because there's any magic associated with turning a page on a calendar. It will be a better year because so many people have fought so hard throughout 2020 and 2021 and will continue to fight. So many people worked their tails off to help elect Joe Biden and Kamala Harris and flip the Senate. So many doctors, nurses, scientists, teachers, food service workers, farm workers, custodians, truck drivers, and other essential workers have kept fighting back against this pandemic, gave us hope in the form of a vaccine and boosters, and kept our country going. I'm deeply grateful that you've helped power our movement to elect Democrats up and down the ballot, lay out plans for bold reform to put people first, and build a foundation for big, structural change. We have a lot of work ahead of us in 2022, and I'm asking if you can chip in to help keep up the fight. When people ask me why I am running for Congress, I tell them I am doing this because I am angry at how our politicians have neglected the needs of Central Washington.
Central Washington still faces the same problems my grandfather talked about 50 years ago. These problems are real challenges that affect the livelihoods of far too many in our community. Under our current leadership, these problems aren’t getting solved. Water shortages, labor shortages, housing shortages, rising costs of healthcare, infrastructure, irrigation — all of these issues are still impacting our communities every day and getting worse.
DC has neglected the needs of Central Washington for decades and it’s time for that to change. Our officials are so busy bickering with each other that they have forgotten about the most pressing issues we face here in District 4. Even our own State Officials have forgotten us. Central Washington is where my roots are and I am dedicated to delivering on policies to build our economy and address our water, immigration, and infrastructure needs.

body:
Happy New Year's Eve, team!

2022 is tomorrow, which means our end-of-year deadline is tonight. It also means we officially have only **158 days** left until the Los Angeles mayoral primary.

Our team is working to raise $20,000 before tomorrow's deadline. That's not a random amount. We've planned out our campaign for mayor through the primary — the doors we need to knock, the calls we need to make, and the voters we need to reach — and raising $20,000 before tonight's deadline is how we start 2022 on the right track.

L.A. is one of the most diverse cities in the country, and it's important my grassroots team reflects that. When folks take a look at who's backing our campaign for mayor, I want them to see representation from people from all walks of life — because that's who makes up L.A.

**[Friend, will you help our campaign reach our $20,000 end-of-year goal so we can start the race to the primary strong? Please chip in what you can before midnight tonight so we can reach our goal and make our vision for L.A. a reality.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40244708/323459132/1938143051?ms=em21_211231_eoy4_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&refcode=em21_211231_eoy4_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&source=em21_211231_eoy4_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_campaign=em21_211231_eoy4_fndd_gq_act___KB_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS85NDYxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NTY5NjI4OS02NjZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QHnEePvQvkwNte82O10xZpqXm19o7m5Gqh1oAab5ZYc=&emci=1e95c910-e661-ec11-94f6-0050f2e65e9b&emdi=95696289-666a-ec11-94f6-0003ffc5857e&ceid=2429742)**

Have a safe and happy New Year,

clean_body: Happy New Year's Eve, team! 2022 is tomorrow, which means our end-of-year deadline is tonight. It also means we officially have only 158 days left until the Los Angeles mayoral primary. Our team is working to raise $20,000 before tomorrow's deadline. That's not a random amount. We've planned out our campaign for mayor through the primary — the doors we need to knock, the calls we need to make, and the voters we need to reach — and raising $20,000 before tonight's deadline is how we start 2022 on the right track. L.A. is one of the most diverse cities in the country, and it's important my grassroots team reflects that. When folks take a look at who's backing our campaign for mayor, I want them to see representation from people from all walks of life — because that's who makes up L.A. A year from today, I want us to be celebrating a new year and a new chapter for L.A. We have the drive and the people-power to create a city built on safety, opportunity, and equity for every community. But I need you to keep fighting by my side. body:
Hello —

I wanted to reach out one last time to humbly ask you to make your first contribution to support my campaign for U.S. Senate in Wisconsin. We need to capitalize on the incredible momentum we’re seeing after a recent poll showed I’m the only Democrat who can defeat Ron Johnson. This is quickly shaping up to be our best online fundraising month since launching this campaign, and I want you to be a part of it.

What we are trying to do in these final hours is generate **as many individual donations as possible** before the final FEC deadline of the year ends. At midnight, it’s over. Ron Johnson will report his fundraising details to the Federal Election Commission and we will, too. Shortly after, those numbers will become public.

Look, I’m not kidding around when I tell you that the first few months of our campaign couldn’t have gone much better than this, and we have folks like you to thank for that. Truly, I cannot thank you enough. But the numbers we put up for this particular deadline couldn’t be more important to the outcome of this race.

The most significant task we have to accomplish over the next year is to gain one more vote in the U.S. Senate to make progress on the issues that matter most to working families, which makes removing Ron Johnson from office essential. The people of Wisconsin deserve a government that is working for them, not big corporations and special interests. That is why I’m running.

Unlike Ron Johnson, I don’t accept any corporate PAC money — never have, never will. Our campaign relies on tens of thousands of people just like you who give a few dollars at a time because they believe in the work we’re doing together. And we need a lot more folks to step up to reach our goals before tonight's deadline.

[**Can you make your first contribution to our campaign before our final FEC fundraising deadline closes at midnight tonight? name: Latham Saddler
subject: A New Year - A Critical Mission
body:
Why I'm On This Mission
---
| | | | | |
---
| |
---
| Fellow Patriot,
As we ring in 2022 and reflect upon everything that has happened over the past year, I wanted to take the time to thank you for your support and remind you why I'm running to be your United States Senator.
As I hope many of you did, I took time over Christmas to be with my family: Melissa and my two young boys. It helped remind me why I'm on this mission and why this next year is so important to all of us.
I never thought when I first got into this race our country could head down such a dangerous path so quickly. But in just one year we have seen what the agenda of President Biden and Senator Raphael Warnock has done to our country:

* Trillions in deficit spending
* Our adversaries empowered overseas
* Massive government overreach and mandates
* An economy crippled by inflation and supply chain issues
* An all-out attack on the American dream via rampant socialist policies
* Open borders, uncontrolled crime, and a lack of respect for our law enforcement

And so, as we make this turn into 2022, and we ramp up our campaign, I wanted to remind you why I'm running.
To me this is more than a job, this is a calling. I first felt the call to serve our nation after September 11th. That calling allowed me to embark on a journey where I spent eight years fighting for our nation as a Navy SEAL Officer and served as Director of Intelligence Programs at the White House on the National Security Council.
But as I look ahead to 2022, I know there is a new battlefield and a new mission. If we are truly going to change the direction of our country and fight for the soul of America, it starts here in Georgia. There is no pathway to stopping the Biden/Pelosi/Schumer machine without us defeating Raphael Warnock.
So, I look to our children's future, and I know there is too much at stake to allow our country to continue down the dangerous path of socialism. I want you to know that I am ready and committed to serve for you once again.
---
|
---
| As we ring in the new year, I ask for your support, your prayers, and most importantly your vote as we head into 2022.
Finally, I just want to thank you for everything you have done for my campaign and let you know that we will be activating the Team Latham coalition soon to win back our country.
Gratefully, Latham

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: personally asking
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I’m reaching out personally to ask for your support and share why your donation before our FEC deadline tonight matters so much for our campaign.

Friends -
I’m reaching out personally to ask for your support and share why your donation before our FEC deadline tonight matters so much for our campaign.
When we launched this campaign, we set out to try something different than what we’ve typically seen in North Carolina — because the old playbook just frankly hasn’t worked.
I believe we must run a people-focused campaign that listens to the hopes and needs of every North Carolinian — particularly those who have been left behind and ignored by Washington. That’s how we will excite and turn out voters from the mountains to the coast, rural and urban alike, and flip this seat.
So far, we’ve had great success. But Republicans have noticed too, and they are worried because North Carolina is one of Democrats’ best chances to flip a Senate seat. The truth is that puts a big target on our campaign.
Republicans are spending millions to hold this seat — including one GOP super PAC planning to spend at least $10 million. So we have to be ready to fight back which is why I’m asking you myself:
**[Will you please make a $3 donation before we close the books on our FEC deadline at midnight? This is a critical moment for us to keep up our momentum.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-dec21?refcode=em211231-1-ma&refcode2=218.357359.y9UEoj&t=1&akid=218%2E357359%2Ey9UEoj)**
We have to build an active and inspiring grassroots campaign here in North Carolina, and doing that is hard work. But with your continued support, we’ll do just that!
Thank you,
Cheri Beasley
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-dec21?refcode=em211231-1-ma&refcode2=218.357359.y9UEoj&t=2&akid=218%2E357359%2Ey9UEoj)**

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

There’s less than 24 hours until our end-of-year fundraising deadline
tonight at midnight.

Right now, we’re 88% of the way toward our goal to raise 5,000 grassroots
donations. We’re cutting it close, but if we pull off one last surge of
donations this morning we can close this gap on time.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14379?refcode=em20211231-1394&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=1394%2E346206%2E2IltYV ]Will you chip in $2.40 or anything you can to help us reach our goal by
midnight tonight? Every dollar you give provides our campaign the funds we
need to build our grassroots organizing strategy, mobilize voters across
Kentucky, and get Rand Paul out of office.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14379?refcode=em20211231-1394&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1394%2E346206%2E2IltYV ][IMG]

This is it,
Peter. Starting tomorrow, we
will only have 11 months to prepare for Election Day and must start
quickly ramping up our campaign so we can out-organize Rand Paul.

That’s why it’s so critical we reach our goal tonight and make sure we
have the funds we need for our big plans. Every dollar you give tonight
goes toward:

* Training organizers so we can directly reach out to voters in all 120
counties of Kentucky
* Printing materials like mailers, campaign posters, and signs
* Affording gas and bus rentals we can travel across Kentucky
* Hiring key campaign staff to expand our capacity
* Acquiring digital tools so we can get our message out to millions of
Kentuckians
* Providing PPE for our campaign office
* And so much more

Our campaign relies on grassroots donations — not corporate PACs or
special interests — to power this work. So when we say we’re relying on
you to do this we mean it,
Peter.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/14379?refcode=em20211231-1394&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=1394%2E346206%2E2IltYV ]Even giving $2.40 makes a big difference: Please chip in now if you
can afford it so we can hit our goal and make sure we have the funding to

| Hi friends, I'm looking ahead to next year and I am ecstatic about the opportunities we will have to shape the future of our state. I know issues like universal pre-K, providing affordable childcare, combating crime, and protecting our environment are critical for Marylanders and I'm running for Governor to deliver on those priorities. Right now, we're making one last push to meet our end of year fundraising goal, and I'm humbly asking for your support. name: Hunter Clapp
subject: Fw: Last Day
body:
Dear Friend,

Tom asked me to resend the email below because it's critical to our race that we raise everything we an before the deadline at midnight.

I know from working with our volunteers here on the ground that we're eager to send Tom to the US House where he can fight against vaccine mandates, for election integrity, and can represent real western Michigan values.

That's why your donation is so important: more than anything, that money funds our ability to get our message out through the mail, on radio, on TV, and on the internet.

I'm confident if we can just reach a majority of the voters in the Republican primary, our victory will be a slam dunk.

Please give what you can, even if it's only a little, at [https://www.tom.gop/donate](https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/lF3KikxWzo82Xcypx892iQhA/g763heo4kAS1ALNv763JqOTDPQ).

Thank you,

Hunter Clapp
Campaign Manager
Norton for Congress

**From:** Tom Norton
**Sent:** Monday, December 27, 2021 8:09 AM
**Subject:** One Week Left

Dear Friend,
I had a wonderful Christmas celebrating the birth of Christ with my family and hope that you did the same.
I'm writing because this is the last week of the financial quarter for my campaign for Congress to defeat Rep. Peter Meijer, a Republican who nearly one year ago voted to impeach President Trump and thought he could get away with it.
Can you help me out with a donation at [https://tom.gop/donate](https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/xldTn9h21hT5UbKwUJuMGQ/g763heo4kAS1ALNv763JqOTDPQ)?
While Peter and I grew up not far from each other, our campaigns could not be more different.
My message is common-sense, West Michigan conservatism and putting America First.
Peter's message is... well, we don't know. He's been in hiding since casting his impeachment vote.
I have held countless public events, recruited an army of volunteers, and never miss an opportunity to speak to conservative organizations in the district.
Peter hasn't held a single town hall or other public event.
And while I'm funding my campaign with contributions from regular, working Americans like you, Peter was born into a billionaire family and can fund his entire campaign with a personal check.
While many of my donors have to choose between contributing to my campaign and other household expenses like rent and food, this equation never enters Peter's mind.
I know expenses may be tight in your household and I can relate. My family, like yours, is also suffering in this Biden Economy where inflation has caused a real pay cut and forced real belt tightening for many of us in Western Michigan and around the country.
That's why I'm especially grateful for anything you can spare. Please, chip in what you can before the deadline at the end of this week at [https://tom.gop/donate](https://contacts.tom.gop//l/Oxl6a1Fvy59S6763vIEQrTBw/xldTn9h21hT5UbKwUJuMGQ/g763heo4kAS1ALNv763JqOTDPQ).
Thank you.

Tom Norton

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

While the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) has broken
multiple fundraising records this year, we’re experiencing a period of
slow fundraising. We’re $10,000 behind what we need to raise before
midnight tonight to meet our December fundraising goal.

Our average contribution is $16.98 because we are powered by people, not
corporate interests. But with record-breaking fundraising numbers, the
political establishment has shown that they aren’t slowing down, and
neither can we.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88645?refcode=em20211231-21223&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA ]If you are with us in the fight to grow our progressive coalition in
Congress, will you chip in $3, $16.98, or anything at all
before midnight? Every dollar gets us closer to meeting our fundraising
goal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88645?refcode=em20211231-21223&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA ]Contribute $3

The DCCC raises money from Wall Street and corporate PACs to recruit
corporate candidates and protect incumbents, while we rely on grassroots
contributions to help elect working-class candidates fighting for
progressive change.

We can’t let the status quo win. Not with so much on the line in the fight
to pass Medicare for All, win a Green New Deal, and expand our coalition
in Congress. The Squad has shown they will buck the Democratic
establishment to fight for the people. Now, we need to make sure we
re-elect AND expand the Squad.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88645?refcode=em20211231-21223&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA ]Please, if you can afford it, chip in to help Justice Democrats reach
our goal before our deadline at midnight

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/88645?refcode=em20211231-21223&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA ]Contribute

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1024&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1025&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20211231-21223-footer&t=1026&refcode2=21223_1203867_LerlaA&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1027&akid=21223%2E1203867%2ELerlaA

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z84ks57nhglrioc8fam0nlbokdonrur2bkvbtk38_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge0o74c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. clean_body: | = Folks, I wanted to bump my last message to the top of your inbox. Michael’s team tells me they still need to raise $4,365 to reach their year-end goal and make the investments that they need to win next year. Michael won his last midterm election by a hair, so anything you can pitch in before the clock strikes midnight tonight will really make a difference. = Thank you and Happy New Year! Susan \-----------------------------------Begin forwarded message----------------------------------- Hey, folks, I hope you’re enjoying the winter holidays. Michael and I have been spending time with the girls reflecting on the year as a whole. Michael’s dedication to our state is clear: opportunities for the next generation, our beautiful public lands, and Colorado’s future guide every meeting he joins, phone call he makes, and every negotiation he leads. Michael is focused on delivering for Colorado. This year: He led the charge to expand the Child Tax Credit, which has helped one million Colorado kids and kept nearly 4 million kids out of poverty nationwide. Michael fought to roll back Trump’s policies that hurt our state’s environment and left Tribal communities out of critical conversations regarding the public lands they hold sacred. He secured a historic investment to expand high-speed internet access to bridge the digital divide for poor, rural, and Tribal communities while helping Coloradans compete in our global 21st-century economy. All this and more makes Michael a top target for the National GOP, but he’s so focused on building on this progress that there isn’t much time to fundraise. Michael’s team says this final end-of-year deadline is one of the most critical. He and his team will need to hit the ground running in January and if they don’t hit their end-of-year goals this month, they might have to scale back on important investments next year. Michael doesn’t take a penny from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists because he works for you, not for any corporate special interests, which makes grassroots donations the heart of this campaign. I can’t wait to see what Michael gets done next year and in his next term, but we can’t get there without your support before Friday’s deadline. Pitch in $10 — or whatever works best for you — to help Michael reach this final end-of-year goal. He’s counting on grassroots supporters like you. body:
Peter,

We want to be completely honest with you: we are worried. As our candidates work their hearts out in advance of tonight's fundraising deadline, we've crunched the numbers, and you're not going to like them.

[_**2021 was the worst year of fundraising for veteran and military family candidates for Congress since 2010**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/1nhj9StaZUWVrCMwM-W2xV1Qd20J_ORz3i3WFbSMn5Y=/1yQIHB_ZXBMD_7yci0K3LGW_p281tQz_xT2Wg0b0kXE=) \- the year of the horrible "red wave," [_**when we lost a staggering SIXTY-THREE (63) seats in the House of Representatives and SIX (6) in the Senate.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/1nhj9StaZUWVrCMwM-W2xV1Qd20J_ORz3i3WFbSMn5Y=/1yQIHB_ZXBMD_7yci0K3LGW_p281tQz_xT2Wg0b0kXE=)

Let's be clear about what that means for November: it means Speaker of the House Kevin McCarthy and Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell. It means hundreds of anti-choice judges and the criminalization of a woman's body. It means the destruction of labor unions, tax cuts for working families, and public health.

[_**In short, disaster.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/1nhj9StaZUWVrCMwM-W2xV1Qd20J_ORz3i3WFbSMn5Y=/1yQIHB_ZXBMD_7yci0K3LGW_p281tQz_xT2Wg0b0kXE=)

Can you chip in right now - before midnight! - to help us fend off disaster?**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/1nhj9StaZUWVrCMwM-W2xV1Qd20J_ORz3i3WFbSMn5Y=/1yQIHB_ZXBMD_7yci0K3LGW_p281tQz_xT2Wg0b0kXE=)

Our nation cannot afford to go back to the days before 2021. We must only move forward. body:

| | | **December 31, 2021** |
---|---|---|---
| | |
### Delivering Federal Investments to Maryland in the Infrastructure Modernization Bill
Last month, President Biden signed into law a historic [infrastructure modernization bill](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-statement-on-passage-of-the-bipartisan-infrastructure-bill-including-key-maryland-priorities&redir_log=119460582231107) - which will fix our crumbling roads and bridges, invest in transit systems and railways in Maryland and across the country, ease supply chain bottlenecks, deliver clean drinking water to all of our communities, and modernize the full array of our infrastructure to meet the challenges of the 21st century - all while creating good-paying jobs. I worked closely with my colleagues in Congress to pass this crucial legislation to build on the progress of the American Rescue Plan, and I was proud to vote to send it to the President's desk. Our state has already started to receive some of [what this law will bring to Maryland](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-secures-key-maryland-priorities-in-infrastructure-modernization-bill-signed-into-law&redir_log=201171204781050), and this month I met with leaders at the local, state, and national levels to discuss how this initiative will support our communities and help working families.

For example, earlier this month, I joined Salisbury Mayor Jake Day to highlight how the infrastructure modernization law can help buttress infrastructure against flooding and extreme weather - a major threat to homes, small businesses, and local economies. This new law directs federal funds toward major Maryland priorities for coastal and waterfront communities like Salisbury, which have experienced an alarming increase in flooding over the past few years that wreaks havoc on residents and businesses alike. I was also pleased to join Vice President Harris, County Executive Angela Alsobrooks, and members of Federal Team Maryland in Prince George's County to discuss how we can make Maryland the electric vehicle capital of the world by leveraging investments in the bipartisan infrastructure law to build out a network of charging stations across our state. And by making the transition from gas to electric, Marylanders will also save money behind the wheel by plugging in their cars for an electric charge instead of filling up their tanks with gas.

Going into the New Year, I will continue to work with colleagues and partners to make sure Maryland reaps the full benefits of this historic law, and I am grateful for the insight, input, and guidance of community leaders, entrepreneurs, and advocates across our state who have helped highlight the unique infrastructure needs of our communities. But we can't stop there.

The full Build Back Better Agenda was designed to invest in a stronger, fairer economy, lower costs for expenses like prescription drugs and child care, extend tax cuts for families with kids, confront climate change, and create more opportunity and more shared prosperity for all. It will be fully paid for by - among other measures - closing tax loopholes that have allowed multi-national corporations to hide profits overseas and by raising tax rates on individuals who make over $10 million per year. We knew from the start that getting all elements of the President's agenda across the finish line wouldn't be easy, but we cannot waver in our determination to get this done. Unfortunately, not a single Republican member of Congress is willing to support this vital national effort. That means we need the votes of all 50 Senate Democrats. I remain confident that we can get it passed. [The time for talking is over](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1473005947002195969&redir_log=122306203609374). The Senate must vote on the Build Back Better Act so our constituents can see where we stand on delivering these priorities to our communities.
---
### Defending Equal Access to the Ballot Box
Around the country, as the poison of Trump's Big Lie continues to spread, Republican-controlled state legislatures are passing laws to make it harder for people to vote - especially people of color and younger voters. That's why Congress must pass the Freedom to Vote Act and the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to establish a minimum set of national standards to ensure equal access to the ballot box and to restore the protections guaranteed by the Voting Rights Act of 1965 that were gutted by the notorious 5-4 Supreme Court decision in _Shelby County v. Holder_. We have no time to waste. This must be the first order of business in January 2022.

Unfortunately, not a single Republican Senator is prepared to join us in passing these bills, and efforts to strike bipartisan compromise have been met with almost zero support on the Republican side of the aisle. Because the Senate GOP refuses to work with us to protect American democracy, the main obstacle standing in the way of getting voting rights protections through Congress is the antiquated and undemocratic filibuster rule, which creates a 60-vote threshold in the Senate to pass legislation - like voting rights - that is not tied to the budget. We can protect the ability of the minority party to fully debate any issue without also allowing them to block the will of the American people. In its current form, the filibuster has only created paralysis that threatens progress - and our fellow citizens cannot afford to wait any longer on voting rights. [Enough is enough](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1471504411402723342&redir_log=12699445095372): we need every senator to recognize that the future of our democracy is at risk and that we must amend or end the filibuster and pass the Freedom to Vote Act and the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.
### Wishing Every Marylander a Happy New Year
We are about to ring in the New Year, and I hope that everyone reading this letter is able to celebrate the start of 2022 with those closest to them in a safe and joyful way. As we turn the page and begin this new chapter, now is also a moment to reflect on all we've achieved over the past 12 months.

We started off 2021 with the swearing in of a new President and got right to work by passing the [American Rescue Plan](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-cardin-secure-maryland-funding-in-senate-passed-american-rescue-plan&redir_log=222465215255927). The American Rescue Plan helped to develop and deploy vaccines more quickly, more efficiently, and more equitably. Those and other efforts have already helped save 1.1 million American lives and prevented over 10 million hospitalizations. But with the rapid spread of the omicron variant, we must continue to ensure that our fellow Marylanders are safe. This is a critical moment, and we must do everything we can to beat back this pandemic. I was pleased to see President Biden unveil his plan to enhance our efforts to fight the virus, including a major expansion of our nation's testing capacity. Under President Biden's leadership, the federal government will start distributing one half billion free at-home tests to Americans starting in January. Testing is an important element of keeping our communities safe, and I am glad that the White House has taken this important step. But the COVID-19 vaccine is still the best possible way to protect yourself and your communities from this deadly virus, and I urge everyone who is eligible to get vaccinated - vaccines are free, safe, and effective. And if you have gotten your first course of the vaccine, make sure to get a booster.

In addition to deploying life-saving vaccines, the American Rescue Plan also delivered relief to those hardest-hit financially and helped our economy rebound. Because of the American Rescue Plan, [our economy is starting to come back stronger and better](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2ftwitter.com%2fChrisVanHollen%2fstatus%2f1469020932413009921&redir_log=819661497487372), with the number of Americans applying for unemployment at the lowest level in 52 years. That landmark legislation also allowed us to invest directly in our communities in a number of ways. Many local and state leaders across Maryland are already using these funds for crucial projects on the ground, such as Baltimore Mayor Brandon Scott's plan to [use funding from the American Rescue Plan to build public Wi-Fi- hot spots](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.facebook.com%2fchrisvanhollen%2fposts%2f459779638843329&redir_log=616134507012388) around the city so we can close the digital divide, which was only exacerbated by COVID-19. In short: the American Rescue Plan was a historic victory for Maryland and for the country.

The Senate followed up that big win by advancing other essential priorities this year, including the infrastructure modernization bill. The Senate also passed the [U.S. Innovation and Competition Act](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-applauds-passage-of-bipartisan-chinese-competition-bill-secures-several-provisions-within-legislation&redir_log=292765880771174), major legislation to boost innovation and grow jobs in Maryland while meeting the rising global challenge of China. That bill must now also pass in the House of Representatives and be signed into law by the President - and taking both of those critical steps must be a top priority in 2022. The Senate was also able to confirm a diverse and historic number of judges to the federal judiciary, including [Deborah Boardman](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-cardin-praise-senate-confirmation-of-judge-deborah-boardman-for-us-district-court-of-maryland&redir_log=104029545671103) and [Lydia Griggsby](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fnews%2fpress-releases%2fvan-hollen-cardin-praise-senate-confirmation-of-judge-lydia-griggsby-for-us-district-court-of-maryland-seat&redir_log=452978118651124), two nominees I was proud to recommend to President Biden to serve our great state of Maryland. In fact, the Senate has now confirmed 22 more federal circuit and district judges during the first year of the Biden Administration than during the first year of the previous one.

We've done all this - and more - but there's still much more work ahead. While we have big challenges to take on in the year to come, I am confident that, with [your continued input](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenVanHollen&crop=15475.30487586.5583071.7517223&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.vanhollen.senate.gov%2fcontact&redir_log=475918421268285) and engagement in our democracy, we will continue to make progress. It's in that spirit that I'd like to wish all Marylanders a happy and safe New Year. Here's to 2022!

Chris Van Hollen

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: The New Year is upon us
body:
Here are my hopes for 2022
---
| | | | | | Volume 22 | December 31, 2021
---
|
---
| A Word From Erik
---
| | |
---|---
|
For many of us, 2021 has not been the easiest of years -- especially as a conservative.
Watching what appears to be the wholesale destruction of our country by radical Left elements in our government has been heartbreaking, distressing and outrageous.
Yet the tide is turning as the American people wake up to the fact that there are those openly working against what is good, virtuous and true in our society.
This is cause for hope.
The country-wide victories from the school board level to city councils, all the way up to the Governorship of Virginia are cause for hope.

If we want 2022 to be a brighter, freer, and more hopeful year, it is ours if we make it so.

Here are some of my hopes for 2022 (politically speaking that is):

1) Republicans will heal their intra-party divisiveness and focus on the true opposition. I strive to follow President Reagan's 11th Commandment (speak no ill of fellow Republicans). With some exciting primaries approaching, we should remember that once the primaries are over, we are all on the same team.
Republicans must stop attacking each other. Labeling someone a RINO just because they disagree is not helpful.

2) Republicans will recognize that we alone cannot win the country back, especially in Colorado where only 28% of the state is Republican. We must find a way to unite as Americans and Coloradans along principles grounded in truth and common to all human beings. The Left would have us more divided because that makes us easier to control (divide and conquer); those of us on the Right must not continue to foster the divide, or we are just as bad as our opposition. We must be the leaders and peacemakers, or the elitists now running the show will continue to capitalize on the divide. This does not mean we align with Socialists, Communists or anarchists who hate this country--it does mean we find common ground with fellow human beings who believe in freedom, truth, justice and rule of law.

3) We elect wise leaders at all levels who have demonstrated their sincerity and willingness to serve the public, even if at great sacrifice. Many career politicians have sold this country out. It's time to replace them with people who run for office as an act of service to their constituency, their state, their country and its Constitution. Let's do our best to support such candidates.

4) Through thoughtful discernment, we tune out the mainstream media (MSM), recognizing them for the dishonest propaganda they foment. Likely if it's from the MSM, it's driven by a manipulated agenda that cares little about the truth. Let's watch the news with healthy skepticism, for most of it is toxic and divisive.

5) More and more, we stop supporting institutions that openly work against American interests. Big Tech corporations are colluding with the Radical Left to censor conservative voices and undermine our founding principles. We must find new solutions that preserve freedom of speech at all costs.

I am hopeful that 2022 continues to see an increasing tide of support for our Nation's founding principles, and a rejection of Socialism writ large. It is time for WE THE PEOPLE to take responsibility for our government at every level.
Until we do, we are complicit with the corruption that we witness in our government today.

For 2022, I pray that we as an American people are blessed with greater wisdom, a greater love for truth, with greater compassion for our neighbor, and a greater capacity for love. We must strive to heal our wounds at every level of society, from the collective to the individual, and this will take leaders of wisdom and character to do so. "Be the change you want to see."

May God bless you and your families as we enter a new and brighter year. Happy New Year!

**As we close the book on 2021, I thought I would reach out and give you a professional threat assessment evaluation**.

**By and large** the single most dangerous threat threatening U.S. hegemony and national security is the alliance between Russia and China. These two countries want the United States to fail. Not do they want to bring out our failure as a country, they’re actively seeking to bring it down from within.

| | My fellow Nebraskans,

The end of a crazy year is finally here (thank the Lord!) I have no doubt that 2022 will include its fair share of twists and turns, but also opportunities to affect meaningful change in our state and country. Lord willing, we will have another year to fight for our freedoms and pass them down to the next generation.

But why is it good that we have another year to "fight"? That doesn't sound like much fun. No - it isn't, but someone has to do it. I would rather it be me than to remain complacent and let the burden fall on my children.

Nevertheless, as long as we continue to stand for what is true and righteous, with integrity, respect, and honor, we can be sure that we are standing on the right side of history. With prayers to the Almighty and fervent sacrifice in the name of liberty, we will prevail and we will continue to live as a free people.

I mean no intent to discourage you, but encourage you! We recently celebrated the most encouraging moment in human history - the birth of our Savior, Jesus! A significant reminder that there is hope and always will be.

Ladies and gentlemen - we are winning.

School boards are being hounded by concerned parents. Elected officials are being held accountable. The "hidden" agenda is being revealed. Americans are waking up.
As we continue our efforts, we will continue to prevail and we will succeed.

I wish you all a very, merry New Year. I look forward to standing with you as our next governor and leading this state to a higher level of freedom, prosperity, and security.

In fervent servitude and humility,

Breland Ridenour

| | What We've Been Up To
---
| | Team Ridenour has been very busy! Apologies for letting the newsletter slip through the cracks. These past few months have held our focus in numerous ways, but it's time to get this thing going again so you can stay in the loop!

Breland has traveled to nearly every county in Nebraska thus far, and will continue doing so - for it is vital that the people get to see the candidates personally, and not just rely on money being spent to tell them who they should vote for. In September he helped man the GOP Booth at the State Fair in Grand Island. It was great seeing so many people from across the state! He also joined fellow patriots at the Convention of States rally held on the Capitol steps. He also had a great time at the Lion's Club - Norfolk annual parade! Back in November, Breland participated in the GOP Gubernatorial Debate held in Weeping Water hosted by the Cass County GOP. It was such a great experience to be able to have the opportunity to stand amongst his opponents and share his platform. The Ridenour family participated in the Nebraska Freedom Rally & Millions March Against Mandatory Vaccination held in Omaha. We held our signs up proudly side by side with fellow Nebraskans to voice our resistance against overreach by the Federal government. Then in December, he also participated in the Agriculture and Rural Issues Republican Gubernatorial Candidate Forum held in Kearney hosted by the Nebraska Farm Bureau. This was yet another great opportunity to voice his platform amongst the competition from the other candidates. Last but certainly not least, Breland and family were honored to join Nebraskans Against Government Overreach for their annual Christmas party! We had a great holiday season, and we hope that you and yours did as well. So yeah - it's been very busy to say the least!

Fellow American,

My name is Rod Dorilás and I’m a candidate for Congress in Florida’s 21st Congressional District.

My opponent isn’t too terribly famous or even a household name. But she’s a Democrat who I’m not convinced still believes that the American Dream is alive.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Next year, people across America will head to the polls with a question on their mind: what did Democrats do to make my life better?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
#
Peter,
By the end of September, climate disasters had already caused over $100 billion in damages in 2021 — surpassing ALL of last year.
**Don't tell me we can't afford bold climate action.**
Less than 25% of workers have paid family leave through their jobs, meaning millions of people can't take time off to care for a new child or a sick loved one.
**Don't tell me paid leave is not essential.**
Since 2018, the 39 largest companies in America have paid ZERO in taxes, despite bringing in $122 BILLION in profits.
**Don't tell me we can't close the loopholes, level the playing field, and tax the rich so they pay their fair share.**

That’s why this 2022 election year is so critica ALERT: ELECTION YEAR STARTS NOW | | Peter, President Biden’s abysmal performance has proven that America needs strong governors more than ever. That’s why this 2022 election year is so critical. It is our chance to turn things around...and that’s why I am running for Governor! I am a Christian. A wife. A mom. A proud Arkansan. My dad always said the real test of a leader is not the way you handle the issues you know are coming - it’s rising to the moment in a crisis you can never plan for. I can say confidently; I learned that lesson while serving President Trump as White House Press Secretary. I was at the table with President Trump confronting our most dangerous adversaries like China and North Korea. We fought and won big fights on tax cuts, the border, and judges. And that track record of success as a true America First patriot has gained me the support of freedom-loving conservatives across the country. Our 45th President, Donald J Trump, Kid Rock, Donald Trump, Jr., and Mike Pompeo are just a few of the long list of conservatives who have endorsed my campaign for Governor. Things have been tough over the last year. We knew that President Biden would be a disaster for Americans, but the worst part of Biden’s misstep after misstep is that we know this is only the beginning. With every move he makes from the White House, he limits your freedom, threatens your livelihood, and he destroys our nation just a little bit more. The only success we’re seeing in America today is in the states led by the governors who are rejecting Biden’s orders and leading in their states. True, conservative, Republican Governors are this nation's last line of defense against the socialist policies of the Democrats in power. That’s what I’m going to do. I’m going to stand firm, fight for our Constitutional values, and make sure we’re leaving a better world for our kids - not the nightmare that Joe Biden wants to leave behind. I know the radical left will do anything to stop me... Because they know I will stand in their way. I will not be intimidated. I will rise to every challenge we will face this year, and I have faith that together, we can save the future nation. I am fighting for you...I will not retreat, not surrender, and I will not bow down to the radical left. Not now. Not ever. If you want to support me, please chip in now to my campaign for governor: Thank you. Happy New Year! 2022 will be We the People's year.

As 2021 comes to an end let's look to 2022 as the year "We the People" stand up for America.

It will take us all working together to ensure freedom for the next generation. We must have hope but we need to also have action behind it.

What does action look like?

It's supporting America First candidates and getting involved in your local community. There are many ways to be involved. Get trained to be an election observer, go to school board meetings, and city council meetings, become a PCO, and help shape the future of Washington State.

subject: 12/31 Newsletter
body:
Happy New Year!

| [ ](http://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/?e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=12_31_newsletter&n=1) | |
---|---|---
[](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYoACmWpbFVl5yir_lA0uM2Gq9g9n79yo2HHshKvg7nExCdQZseeTdqQcxnA0-13oGA&e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=12_31_newsletter&n=2) Dear Peter -- Happy New Year! This year is an important one for our state. We can all agree that as we look back on 2021, our state is in serious trouble and Governor Pritzker and the Democrat majority in the House and the Senate have no clue how to fix it. Skyrocketing property taxes, a slow or no growth economy, rising crime and crushing pension deficits are tanking our once great state. The only way we can hope to turn our state around is to fire the current leadership. I am resolved this New Year’s to make JB Pritzker a one-term governor. I am the Republican candidate best able to accomplish this mission because of my experience building successful businesses and because of the passion I have for this state. When you read about companies being contacted by other states to leave Illinois, understand that this is not a talking point. It is real. My businesses like so many other Illinois businesses are approached all of the time about packing up and leaving Illinois. The arguments these competing states make is compelling. But just like my determination to keep my businesses in Illinois, I am resolved to make our state a destination for jobs and opportunities instead of a leader in outmigration. Best Regards, Gary Rabine **Will you join our growing movement to defeat JB Pritzker?****** Join Team Rabine to learn how you can be a part of the winning team to defeat JB Pritzker and help turn our state around! | [](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/volunteer?e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=12_31_newsletter&n=3 "Join Team Rabine") [Join Team Rabine](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/volunteer?e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=12_31_newsletter&n=3)
---
* * *
### **New York style vaccine mandates come to Illinois **
That did not take long to escalate. The City of Chicago and now Cook County are requiring proof of vaccination for patrons of indoor businesses such as bars, restaurants, and gyms. In Cook County, businesses are required to check the vaccination status of everyone even children as young as five years old.
The same people who have failed to keep citizens safe and who continue to plunge both the City of Chicago and Cook County government into a financial abyss somehow think they are qualified to respond to the current pandemic.
What a complete joke. These unenforceable edicts are nothing but an overreach from incompetent, career politicians who are fiddling while Cook County and Chicago burn.
These policies are not going to solve any public health issue, but they will hurt businesses and infringe on the basic rights of Cook County residents. We deserve better than the JB Pritzker, Lori Lightfoot, and Toni Preckwinkle.
### People leaving Illinois in droves
The annual US Census Bureau population estimates show Illinois has lost 406,000 people since 2014.
That is like losing the entire population of Joliet and Aurora combined.
Houston, we have a problem.
Poor financial policies, massive tax increases and a poor business climate are driving people out of Illinois. Population loss means jobs lost and a higher tax burden on those who still remain.
Don’t believe me? Consider this. Illinois has lost more than 24,000 manufacturing jobs in the last 10 years while surrounding states have **GAINED** manufacturing jobs.
This is what happens when you allow incompetent people to run your state. Career politicians don’t know how to build anything except their campaign war chests through the time-honored Illinois tradition of graft and influence peddling.
It is time for the people of Illinois to wake up and make sure the career politicians and political insiders who are profiting from our state’s decline never have access to political power again.
Below is the annual estimated Illinois population loss by year:
2021: 114,000
2020: 80,000
2019: 51,250
2018: 45,000
2017: 40,000
2016: 38,000
2015: 25,000
2014: 10,000
Illinois deserves better than the poor leadership of JB Pritzker and his allies in the House and the Senate.
### **Illinois Senate leader carjacked **
State Senator Kimberly Lightford and her husband Eric McKennie were carjacked during an incident in Chicago that concluded with a shootout between McKennie and the suspects.
"I thought for sure they were gonna shoot me down,” Lightford said. “It was a lot of shots being fired. I think they were shooting at my husband and me and luckily enough my husband is concealed carry, and he was able to protect us."
What happened to Lightford and her husband is terrifying. It should never happen to anyone. Period. I hope our leaders are paying attention to what is going on in the streets of Chicago.
We need to take this problem seriously. If there is any good to come from this horrific incident – it should be a concerted bipartisan effort to protect honest citizens.

| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001SKdH4yZkmCFa_KtUqjI8vFxNsti_z1Du_cxoQY7HqYADfmIPIt8oSQWhHkTf8Ywief4O4cguo2kCcbH9wukX52POrA8Yg3OXdSB9W-eVp0_j2cFX5JBqpM-bre_KHYUwFHFMq_AZRzV2lXE2v8y9W8Ib45Z8bOYx7Dv06cV6nivxbAvIsJkafRQ8wfinMgWS&c=2sHkG30fNZgr8gZxN8Dz27phuyOiJzJMrF8TgxclOMuqcrqvvngOJw==&ch=JmElas9I9h24ChYW43rxCGK3eNdgF0EjO-JPEuoJQacd2FKXIUhU7g==)
---
| Peter,
As this year comes to a close and 2022 is on the horizon, I've had time to reflect on all we have accomplished in the great state of Florida under Governor DeSantis' leadership. I'm proud to say no governor has been as steadfast in protecting the liberty and freedom of the people they represent this year than our governor, and my husband, Ron DeSantis. He held his ground and spent much of 2021 blazing a path and setting an example that other elected officials across the country followed, and more Americans had their God-given rights protected as a result. While other states and cities debated defunding police, Ron has supported law enforcement and making sure those on the front lines know he has their backs. He's made Florida the best state in the nation for members of law enforcement, and our children and communities are safer today as a result. Instead of shutting our businesses down and sending fellow Floridians to the unemployment line, Ron has Florida's economy roaring even beyond pre-pandemic levels. As other states revert back to remote schooling that harms the mental health and education outcomes for our children, Ron has kept Florida's children in school and made sure Florida's teachers feel our appreciation for their hard work. And when students are in the classroom, Ron's ensured they aren't being indoctrinated with propaganda that teaches them to hate one another or hate America. The results speak for themselves here in the Sunshine State. More people came to Florida than any other state last year because they want to live under the freedom and prosperity our governor has created. I'm so proud of the job Ron has done and I'm so thankful to live in Florida under his courageous leadership. As we prepare to head into a new year, we know the fight that awaits. The 2022 election transcends typical politics. We're at an inflection point that will decide the direction of our state for generations to come. I know Ron is ready to keep fighting for YOU and for Florida. If his last three years as governor are any indication, he's only just begun to fight. Sincerely, Casey DeSantis
---

| | Friday, December 31, 2021
---
|
---
| | It's time to close the door on 2021! It has been a hell of a year. Somehow, the insurrection on our Capital, the release of COVID vaccinations for the public, Tampa Bay winning the Super Bowl, the Amanda Gorman poem, WandaVision, the Nina Turner campaign, Jon Gruden getting fired from the Raiders, the Delta and Omicron variants, the release of the Snyder Cut, and Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema turning into the Team Rocket of the Democratic Party all happened over the last 12 months. I started this campaign over a year ago, under the belief that the people of Florida would respond to a real Progressive candidate who put them ahead of big party politics and corporate interests. Since then, I have travelled the state, visiting 65 out of the 67 counties, and holding or attending events in 48 of them. I've met voters from every type of background across our incredibly diverse state, and I stand here today more convinced than ever that 2022 is the year of the Progressive. The American people have problems that require progressive solutions, they need the government to use their tax dollars to ensure they can live safe and free in this great nation of ours. When the most well-funded government in the history of the world can't find a way to ensure that every citizen has clean water, something is wrong. I was tired of seeing candidates brag about how much money they raised (from corporations and Super PACs) and then refuse to support Medicare for All, or the Green New Deal, or Federal Legalization of Marijuana, or Universal Voting Rights. It's time to remind them all that winning an election doesn't mean that you're in charge, it means that you're responsible to serve the people who elected you.
---

| | Today is the last day of 2021, which means it's the last day of the quarter for FEC fundraising. We're looking to add an extra $15,000 to our End of Year numbers, and start the year off with the money we need to put resources in the hands of all of our new volunteers who have signed up to go out to festivals and events in their counties, to speak with voters and make sure they know there is a Progressive Candidate who is running for them. Every dollar helps, every donor on our report shows the growing strength of this campaign. $10, $5, even if it's just $1, please, click that button and show your support today!

"Get on the Ballot" will feature four AMAZING speakers telling their incredible and unique stories, this is an event you won't want to miss. Purchase your tickets now by clicking the banner below.
