body:
Powerful special interests are hoping to see our movement lose momentum.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20211231-2719-header&t=1&akid=2719%2E2526796%2E6R8H09)
We want to talk about why this month is so important for our campaign.
At midnight, our campaign will close our books and submit a public report to the FEC detailing how much we’ve fundraised in the last three months.
As one of the most heavily targeted members of Congress, Alexandria’s report will draw huge attention from political opponents, pundits, and powerful special interests who are hoping to see our movement lose momentum.
Alexandria has spent this past month speaking truth to power: From taking on Senator Joe Manchin over his breach of trust on Build Back Better, to calling on President Biden to cancel student debt, to holding Republicans accountable for violent Islamophobia against their colleagues, to pressuring our own party to step up and use the tools at our disposal to govern for working families.
We know that whenever Alexandria uses her voice to call out corruption and fight for the people, those special interests will look for ways to put a stop to our movement especially as we head into an election year.
**That’s why it’s critical that this quarter is our best fundraising quarter yet.** The amount of contributions we receive — no matter the amount — will help show that Alexandria and our unapologetic fight for systemic change has strong support — from your state and across the country.
[Can you make a $3 contribution right now to show your support for Alexandria on this report and help our campaign hit this critical fundraising goal before the end of the year?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-1?refcode=em20211231-2719-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2719_2526796_6R8H09&akid=2719%2E2526796%2E6R8H09)
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-1?refcode=em20211231-2719-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&refcode2=2719_2526796_6R8H09&akid=2719%2E2526796%2E6R8H09)**
Our movement has always been driven by the dedication of individual, small-dollar donors like you giving an average of just under $20. We’re proud of that fact.
Because when hundreds of thousands of people chip in $5, $10, and $20 at a time, it all adds up to compete against the billionaires and corporations who use their money to rig the political system in their favor.
But, candidly, our fundraising has slowed down since the summer months this year, and we’re relying on your support today to get back on track, hit this goal, and keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for bold solutions for working families.
[Can we count on you to chip in $3 or whatever you can right now to help post the strongest FEC report possible and power our movement forward?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-1?refcode=em20211231-2719-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=2719_2526796_6R8H09&akid=2719%2E2526796%2E6R8H09)
This work wouldn’t be possible without you.
Thank you for everything,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-1?refcode=em20211231-2719-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&t=23&refcode2=2719_2526796_6R8H09&akid=2719%2E2526796%2E6R8H09)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20211231-2719-P_FND_EOQ_GOL&t=24&akid=2719%2E2526796%2E6R8H09)**

name: Taylor Keeney for Congress
subject: For now, I just want to say thank you.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TAYLOR KEENEY FOR CONGRESS
body:

recognizing that our district, our country, and Congress had big issues that

<>

Dear Friend,

Five months ago, we jumped into the race for Congress in the 7th District
recognizing that our district, our country, and Congress had big issues that
needed to be fixed. I was motivated to run because I’m a problem solver and
Washington, D.C. is in sore need of new conservative leadership and fresh ideas.

Unfortunately, redistricting did not turn out as we had hoped. Carter and I,
and our family, live in Goochland – that’s home. With the final maps issued by
the Virginia Supreme Court, Goochland is now in the 5th Congressional District.
I am a big believer that you should run where you live. And so, I will not be
continuing my campaign for Congress in the 7th District and do not intend to
run in the 5th District against Congressman Bob Good. Now, more than ever, it
is critical we elect a strong Republican majority to Congress, to retire
Speaker Pelosi, and stop President Biden’s radical agenda.

I am so grateful for all of the support our campaign received over the last
five months. Running for Congress has been an incredible experience. From
sitting with restaurant owners barely able to keep the lights on, to talking
with inmates on the path to recovery, and enjoying countless coffees with
people from all across the Commonwealth – I have met so many amazing people and
enjoyed every moment traveling throughout 10 counties in Central Virginia.

We appreciate the encouragement to consider other offices, but Carter and I
are now going to take some time to figure out what exactly the future holds.
Regardless of what we decide, I am going to be supporting candidates across
Virginia – particularly women and younger candidates running for office. It’s
long past time for more conservative women to serve our Commonwealth in the
General Assembly and in federal office.

For now, I just want to say thank you. It’s an incredibly humbling experience
to run for office, and while I’m disappointed this campaign is coming to an end
too soon, I’m not going anywhere; I will continue to serve my community however
I can.

Thank you for all of your support over the last five months!

Sincerely,
<>
Taylor Keeney

Here’s what we’re looking at: On January 1st, our 2021 fundraising numbers will be final — and we’ll see how much this campaign has to work with to start the year strong. On January 15th, we’ll ramp up our online presence with digital ads to spread the word about Steve’s accomplishments and combat negative ads from the GOP. By February 1st, we’ll pick up the pace on our on-the-ground organizing efforts to make sure we’re reaching out to voters in every corner of the state. **** | | | This strategy depends on what we’re able to accomplish in the next 12+ hours. If we miss our fundraising goal, we won’t have the resources to take on Steve’s 6 Republican opponents and the GOP war chest. Our incredible team came together in 2018 to flip Nevada blue — and I know that with the same determination and grit we can KEEP it blue in 2022. body:
It’s New Year’s Eve and I’m sure you are busy, so I’ll keep it short.
#

Friends,
Today is the last chance for you to help us reach our $300,000 December goal. It’s also New Year’s Eve, so, I’ll keep it short:
[**Can you make a donation to Giffords before midnight? Your contribution will go directly towards saving lives this holiday season.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-dec21-eom?refcode=em211231-1-30&t=1&refcode2=1411_3935704_5fs0lc&akid=1411%2E3935704%2E5fs0lc)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-dec21-eom?refcode=em211231-1-30&t=2&refcode2=1411_3935704_5fs0lc&akid=1411%2E3935704%2E5fs0lc)**
As 2021 comes to a close, I have reflected on how much work we have accomplished together in 2021.
Universal background checks passed in the House. We filed a lawsuit against the NRA for corrupting our government by making millions of dollars in illegal contributions to political campaigns. We raised attention to federally ban ghost guns. And in the coming year, we are going to accomplish even more.
I need your help so that we have the momentum we need going into the new year. The gun lobby will stop at nothing to roll back all of our hard work and decades of progress we have made.
Please, donate here:
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/December**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-dec21-eom?refcode=em211231-1-30&t=3&refcode2=1411_3935704_5fs0lc&akid=1411%2E3935704%2E5fs0lc)
Thank you for being a part of this team. Because of you we were able to make 2021 a year of progress and I know we will accomplish even more in 2022.
Happy New Year!
All my best to you and yours,
_Gabby_

# There are only a few hours left to 2021. Can you help us?
2021 is almost over! It's hard to believe. I am sure I am not the only one who feels like this year has felt much longer than just 365 days. In 2021 we had so many challenges - not the least of which was how the COVID pandemic affected our community. But we also saw what happens when we come together.

This is why I am running for Congress. Throughout my entire life, I have seen the power of movements. I know that we can make incredible things happen. And I know that now more than ever, we need to work together to make change. We can bring bout universal healthcare, economic security, housing stability, clean energy, and criminal justice reform.

We can not do this alone! As the clock strikes midnight, it will mark the end of 2021 and the end of our Q4 fundraising deadline. [I am asking you to please make a donation to our campaign](https://drameena.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e8541e883c7e489c2cd5d45b&id=24e6d5828f&e=5fba611a2c). I am running against an incumbent who has been in office for 29 years and has deep pockets. [I could use your help.](https://drameena.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9e8541e883c7e489c2cd5d45b&id=a31f8bc2aa&e=5fba611a2c)

Thank you all so much for the incredible support. I am running for Congress to work for you.

In Solidarity,

Dr. Ameena

This is why I am running for Congress. Throughout my entire life, I have seen the power of movements. I know that we can make incredible things happen. | With the clock counting down on our final chance to boost the America First movement before 2022, I'm reaching out one last time to [ask for backup.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001820PPvCAMKOPZzrPikxYNciVlcj5iqO887UkDXo-6cGLhvzg-QZtmJliGMqtJIgFFEx6NKVjaI5EEkT3Tu_1J2PSOArwvk17ZAEeoKOG-Fj6EeTdsKPwIFkORkCNr_AqnO6s9eWgybR43z1smC2g3FpyStbSwufdBEtPgiN8tZQ=&c=W0pPr5iS5338GREJp6VN0uJw46qtArNBrhaz210dJ9Ofz8qTATDFwQ==&ch=QV0M6EUvWflHj28bYGiquH6S-9x92WPv2QAaNr6o7M0U0bntVWXTBA==)
Our fight isn't funded by lobbyists, by Big Pharma and Big Tech giants, or by Swamp PACs...
[It's supported by everyday, patriotic Americans like you who value freedom and who won't let it slip into the hands of Deep State tyrants.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001820PPvCAMKOPZzrPikxYNciVlcj5iqO887UkDXo-6cGLhvzg-QZtmJliGMqtJIgFFEx6NKVjaI5EEkT3Tu_1J2PSOArwvk17ZAEeoKOG-Fj6EeTdsKPwIFkORkCNr_AqnO6s9eWgybR43z1smC2g3FpyStbSwufdBEtPgiN8tZQ=&c=W0pPr5iS5338GREJp6VN0uJw46qtArNBrhaz210dJ9Ofz8qTATDFwQ==&ch=QV0M6EUvWflHj28bYGiquH6S-9x92WPv2QAaNr6o7M0U0bntVWXTBA==)
So in order to compete with the forces that are financing the America Last uniparty, we need to be ready to fight back in a big election year and have our movement take back a majority worth having.
We can get an America First Congress that will do REAL oversight, not one that's focused on keeping up the witch hunt against President Trump and his supporters like you!
If that's a fight you're on board for, then support it one last time before 2022 - and then we can get to work showing our America Last detractors in the DOJ, at CNN, and elsewhere in the Swamp that NOTHING they do can stop our movement!

Midnight doesn't just mark the end of 2021 – it also marks our most important deadline of the year. I'm hoping to count on your support to help us reach our goal so we can end the year strong and hit the ground running in the election year.

name: Great America Update
subject: Unlock the Federalist Papers
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6612%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=oQhXnJ0ftQQ2GeY3LhqP0Q&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68382%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TVKyHY4%2f%2bNdZm%2fT4mBqXrA&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American,
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well.
Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** --not adequate for the challenges of our time.
How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges?
Well, a few early champions of the Constitution--Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison--have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_.
Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution.
Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.”
That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves.
**So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.**
_**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more.
The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68383%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=mgvZVDs8hVeVRJY%2fGB25nQ&sysid=1) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long.
Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c68384%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uYELSG%2buN968aT%2fuDgYsHw&sysid=1)
Warm regards,
Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

| **_2022: A Year of Opportunity_** There are just hours until midnight and I wanted to be the first to wish you a Happy New Year and let you know what lies ahead for us in 2022.

With voters rejecting the far-left policies of Joe Biden and the Democrats, 2022 will be a year of opportunity, not just for us here in Indiana, but across the country. For the first time ever, Indiana’s First Congressional District is in play as a potential Republican pick-up. We’ll do everything we can to make that pick-up a reality, retain our current seats, and help lead the Republican take-back of the U.S. House. And in the U.S. Senate, we’ll secure Todd Young’s seat beyond a doubt and give Republicans the momentum to reestablish a conservative majority.

As we've shown time and time again, if we focus and work together as Republicans, we simply can’t lose.

Let's make 2022 no different.

May you have a blessed and prosperous new year.

Kyle Hupfer
Chairman, Indiana Republican Party

| | **Governor Holcomb's Week That Was**
---
|
---
| _**Continuing the Fight Against COVID-19**_ **Governor Holcomb** was joined by state health officials Kris Box, M.D. and Chief Medical Officer Lindsay Weaver to address the recent surge of COVID-19 cases. During the briefing, it announced that the Indiana Department of Health has partnered with the Indiana National Guard to deploy six-person teams to nearly two dozen hospitals to help with staffing shortages. Each team will be deployed in two-week increments, with each hospital having the option to request a two-week extension. **Gov. Holcomb** thanked healthcare workers for their efforts, stating that they are making a "huge difference" in the state's fight against COVID-19. "I know how tired you are. You are making a difference one family at a time." In step with his previous comments on the importance of utilizing the vaccine as the best tool to protect against COVID-19, **Gov. Holcomb** stated: _“If you have been vaccinated and you’ve gotten your booster, that’s not all you can do. And if you can appeal to folks who are skeptical of the efficacy of the vaccine please do that. You may be the person someone trusts that’s holding out. I’ve heard these cases too. It could be in the Y, it could be at church. If you play bridge with a group, who knows what the group is, but if you are a trusted individual in your cohort, you can make the differences in someones else’s families.”_

body:

College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zqefeaganefukaqmb9nmi36libcobds381vtr508_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2ztq73femn5iuj7nnjn4gt42r4h47kals0nrjovkg_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zf2pfq0stda54h4dfhsj1mc5bs66q4806ei048d0_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2z8t8o9s2bgujarlb7s31ljgotb8p995jouotueko_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zoohpehlj0t629mgcmht11t69uvt0uued5qmvb2o_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zdqi5veaa6j3f15qo9jnh4jd6ms0vd17f924hjl8_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zcumrl8bf6sq1daveqtn9l3iko4m6tcrfkd37g4o_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2zacj579el949hb2rcn5pgnesnc99aavg0nensg00_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs) Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://e.selfreliancecentral.com/rd/9z2z6075f7kqvcnh5rp8io5emr1ru6d0u3r539rle40_rp22sh2s8i66ob0cjge9o74c5h2bs)

Hey there, this is the last time you’ll hear from us this year, so we’ll keep this message incredibly short and let you get on with your celebrations. In a few hours, we’ll not only ring in the new year — but we’ll also close the books on the most important Texas Ethics Commission filing deadline we’ve faced so far. body:
Peter,

2021! You're done! We have so much to be thankful for, and so much work ahead. I know that many of us are dealing with challenges today, but I want you to know that I'm thinking of you, and I believe in you.

I know that 2022 will be a better year for all of us.

Taking the Hill has been proud this year to stand with so many strong veteran and military family candidates of integrity for Congress. Friends you know, like Senators Tammy Duckworth, Raphael Warnock, and Mark Kelly. And some new members of our family: Marcus Flowers, Chris DeLuzio, and Julia Brownley.

In the new year, our mission is as clear as ever: [_**elect more veterans and military family members to Congress.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/gxb7m5S4zR019rW9GVIMGVzbtfpgfaYdityRZYlIfbY=/pR_Xi-dF2hs3luIQC84SE1v_bJKqlqaqq-JtT-TlgY8=) We have never had fewer elected before in our nation's history - and it shows.

Tonight is the most important fundraising deadline of the year. One last time in 2021, I'm asking you to come through for us. [_**Chip in as much as you can tonight to help us ring in 2022 on a positive footing.**_](https://act.myngp.com/el/gxb7m5S4zR019rW9GVIMGVzbtfpgfaYdityRZYlIfbY=/pR_Xi-dF2hs3luIQC84SE1v_bJKqlqaqq-JtT-TlgY8=) I can't tell you how much it means to me to see your contributions come through.

My love and support is with you. Enjoy the evening wherever you are, and ring in the new year with strength, positivity, and hope.

Happy New Year,
Patrick

Fellow Republican,
I hope you’re enjoying the start of your New Year’s celebrations with your friends and family.

I hate to interrupt, so I’ll make it quick.

We fought to protect life at the Supreme Court. We sued Joe Biden to STOP his unconstitutional vaccine mandate. We didn’t let out-of-state liberals dictate our priorities. We stood together, and we stood strong.

Now, I need each and every one of you to step up and help make 2022 just as successful.

Together, we will work to make this the year we _**eliminate the state income tax.**_

**Please make a contribution today and help us start 2022 strong.**

body:
Glad I caught you, friend.

I'm sure you're getting ready to ring in the new year, so I'll be quick.

I'm checking one last time before tonight’s end-of-year fundraising deadline (it hits at midnight). My team tells me we’re still just short of our goal -- only $3,091 left to raise.

I know we’ve emailed a lot. But I don't want to start the new year in regret that we didn't do enough to hit this critically important goal.

If you haven’t yet, can you use this link to chip in your donation before midnight? **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gash-q4-2021](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40254548/323504910/1573898945?refcode=em-12.31.21-all-3-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDg3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YjY0YTM2MC04ZDZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pI0j29HBQzNboCk2al_BF6DE6nb2Zdl8lamK5ZzxVuE=)**

body:
The story of our nation is good, engaged people like you remaining focused when things get tough, and not submitting to the discouragement that the obstacles ahead might put in our way.
I know that you're worried about the progress this team can make moving forward – I am, too, but that's why folks like you and I are in this fight. And I want you to remember the huge steps Democrats have taken toward mending our country.
Just think about how President Biden and congressional Democrats vaccinated millions of Americans – and how our Democratic majority is helping small businesses and working families recover from the pandemic. This majority is repairing roads and bridges while creating green jobs. That progress was only possible because of our narrow Senate majority, which is in dire jeopardy: So I'm going to take this moment to ask you to give $5} right now, to help me flip Florida blue and defend our majority and chance at progress. [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email?refcode=jtk1916-fr-text]
But, I'm also asking you to donate to my campaign and imagine how much more this majority can do. In 2022, this team has the opportunity to help expand our Senate majority, to make sure a 50-50 Senate doesn't stall any more progress: from voting rights to gun reform to reproductive freedom.
Florida is our best chance to flip a seat from red to blue and expand our Senate majority, to expand our potential for that progress. But I need to raise $250,000 before my End of Year deadline at midnight – and I'm falling $15,668 short as of 6p.m.
My race is an incredible opportunity to build a majority committed to change – CNN is calling Florida a top pickup opportunity for Democrats – so will you donate $5 right now to help me meet my goal before the clock strikes midnight and expand our Senate majority? [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email?refcode=jtk1916-fr-text]
The fight for the transformational agenda that Americans need starts right now – because come January, my fundraising numbers will be public. With the race between Marco Rubio and me tightening, national Republicans are going to attack me with everything they have – and the GOP will double down if they see any weakness in my fundraising.
In a race that recent polls have within the margin of error, I can't just sit back and hope for the best – especially when losing means this country won't have the chance to pass gun reform, safeguard reproductive freedom or expand access to health care. So I can't afford to miss this fundraising goal.
That's why I'm counting on you tonight. I'm still $15,668 short of my FEC End of Year goal, and I need you to help me make up the difference before midnight. The strength of our movement will be judged by our resources when our numbers go public, so please give now:
Can I count on you to help me start off 2022 strong? Please donate $5 before our midnight FEC End of Year deadline to flip Florida blue and expand our Democratic Senate majority. [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email?refcode=jtk1916-fr-text]

Thank you for being part of this movement, Friend. I'm so grateful for your support.
Val Demings

I’m relying on grassroots supporters like you, donating to emails like this, to help me defeat Marco Rubio and stop Mitch McConnell from flipping the Senate. | | On January 20th, we were moved when youth poet laureate Amanda Gorman read her poem, _The Hill We Climb_ , at the Inauguration of President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris. We think her new poem, _New Day’s Lyric_ , is just as insightful, as we reflect on this past year and look towards 2022. May this be the day
We come together.
Mourning, we come to mend,
Withered, we come to weather,
Torn, we come to tend,
Battered, we come to better.
Tethered by this year of yearning,
We are learning
That though we weren’t ready for this,
We have been readied by it.
We steadily vow that no matter
How we are weighed down,
We must always pave a way forward. This hope is our door, our portal.
Even if we never get back to normal,
Someday we can venture beyond it,
To leave the known and take the first steps.
So let us not return to what was normal,
But reach toward what is next. What was cursed, we will cure.
What was plagued, we will prove pure.
Where we tend to argue, we will try to agree,
Those fortunes we forswore, now the future we foresee,
Where we weren’t aware, we’re now awake;
Those moments we missed
Are now these moments we make,
The moments we meet,
And our hearts, once all together beaten,
Now all together beat. Come, look up with kindness yet,
For even solace can be sourced from sorrow.
We remember, not just for the sake of yesterday,
But to take on tomorrow. We heed this old spirit,
In a new day’s lyric,
In our hearts, we hear it:
For auld lang syne, my dear,
For auld lang syne.
Be bold, sang Time this year,
Be bold, sang Time,
For when you honor yesterday,
Tomorrow ye will find.
Know what we’ve fought
Need not be forgot nor for none.
It defines us, binds us as one,
Come over, join this day just begun.
For wherever we come together,
We will forever overcome.

Peter – I promise there's a good reason why I'm emailing you the night of New Year's Eve. You see, I'm up against a really important deadline of my own tonight. When the ball drops, time's up on the final fundraising quarter of 2021, and what we've raised in our race to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA) will be publicly reported to the FEC. As of right now, I'm still $7,280 short of what we need to raise before this deadline. We're _so close_ to hitting this goal, so I hope you'll give me a moment to explain why making up this final gap is important.
You see, when our fundraising numbers go public, the political pundits and GOP establishment and even Sen. Grassley himself will look at them to judge the strength of our campaign. Hitting big goals like this will determine whether we're able to go toe-to-toe with Republican spending. Whether we can get our first TV ads up quickly and reach voters. Whether or not we enter the election year strong and ready to compete.
But for me, it's a whole lot deeper than all that – because defeating Sen. Grassley isn't just about flipping a Senate seat blue. It's about fighting for working families like my own, whom Sen. Grassley turned his back on long ago. It's about what used to be an easy notion of standing up for our democracy. It's about giving working families a real sense of hope in who's fighting for _them_ in the Senate.
So please, I know it's late, and I'm sure you've got a lot on your mind as we enter the new year – but I've got to ask just once more: Can you please help us hit our final goal of the year by donating $5 or whatever you can spare? Every single dollar will fuel our campaign to defeat Sen. Grassley, protect our Senate majority and fight for working families. Here's the best link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/abby-finkenauer-email**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40255967/323509956/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk478-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MGM3OTU0NC05MjZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=RsD2TMpp89zs9B6OjmahRtO5n3xd-gaqwntIciAedwI=)
Thank you so much – and Happy New Year!

With gratitude,

body:
I am humbly reaching out one last time.

| Peter,

Education can be the difference between life and death. And I know that because it was for me.

Public school teachers are the reason I am alive, they are the reason I became a teacher, they are the reason I had the privilege to serve as President Barack Obama’s Secretary of Education, and they are the reason I am running for governor today.

They gave me hope for what was possible in life and created exceptional opportunities for me that I otherwise would have never known. But I know teachers and public schools can’t do it alone. There’s work that needs to be done on economic development, housing, affordable health care, environmental justice, and so much more – and I’m ready to get to work as Maryland’s next Democratic governor.

As you know, we’re closing in on the final fundraising deadline of the year in just a few hours, **so I am humbly reaching out one last time to ask: before we close the books on 2021, will you chip in for the first time and support our efforts to improve the lives of Marylanders?[_https://secure.actblue.com/donate/king_q4_em_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40256173/323511055/1830086357?refcode=BLU-KING-20211231-nd-EM&&&&amount=25&refcode2=c2cd457a-936a-ec11-94f6-0003ffc5857e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmNkNDU3YS05MzZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qqYrMGaCe73t_TbgAgW0n-5Ka-_fMkbk7oOxdxddgC4=)**

People from across the state and the nation have shown us immense support, and I hope that you will join us. Whether you can afford to chip in $1, $100, or more, grassroots donations allow my team and me to expand the reach of our operation to connect with voters in every corner of the state. **So, please, before we reach our December fundraising deadline, will you pitch in today to help us build a brighter Maryland and guarantee opportunity for all?** [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/king_q4_em**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/40256174/323511056/1830086357?refcode=BLU-KING-20211231-nd-EM&&&&amount=25&refcode2=c2cd457a-936a-ec11-94f6-0003ffc5857e&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMmNkNDU3YS05MzZhLWVjMTEtOTRmNi0wMDAzZmZjNTg1N2UiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qqYrMGaCe73t_TbgAgW0n-5Ka-_fMkbk7oOxdxddgC4=)

Hey Peter, as we come to the end of 2021 I want to reflect on my filing to be on the ballot and my trip to Mayfield, and I want to ask you to verify your voter registration status and consider a year end donation.
* **I filed to be on the ballot.** While I have been officially filed with the FEC for a while, I was able to file with our Secretary of State and will officially be on the primary ballot as a Democratic candidate in May. If you live in Kentucky, I would be honored if you would consider voting for me.

---
|
---
* **We visited the tornado sights in Mayfield.** I was honored to partner with Louisville Mayoral candidate to help collect donations for families in Mayfield, KY. I was able to spend a day in Mayfield with his team and meet so many amazing people there. Thank you to everyone who contributed donations. It is making a difference in the lives of people in Mayfield.

---
|
---
* **Today is the last day to change your voter status in****KY.** If you are already registered to vote as another party, but would like to as a Democrat in the KY primary, today is the last day you can update your party. It only takes 5 minutes to update your status and you can do so by going to: [https://vrsws.sos.ky.gov/ovrweb/](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/7m9VDUTsZHJXsX_nbnqDrXb9PIJXlwVTjs61ylADrmuqWTeH4vo4byS5Mtr3Suwsm8bu1YslsWhDrH-rLQsHlqKq-LqWTM0YUSwDZ4llPUMPRMMaJojAZeMnzfH0ATPigmXhfOiB4S3dNCmtRN4jkXGHQZnXCQopP3O-RtWYdWPv1GYRhdFy2U_v6gzd1HLztaIy2bCMEMmXUUjtIOHqPiKcpes4Lvj4Xzq-5RoKkrKTEpy7H2ptAgyHC7aI0QX2/3ib/tOdcO8RxRnmcnwWQHOtmCw/h1/dnLCqvGw5gFd9IgM3g0RXLFfMYU5_N1LS5_NsacGaX0)
* **Please consider a Year****End****Donation.** I know everyone is asking for your money, but I would ask you to either consider a donation to our team today, or to consider making a donation to us a part of your New Years Resolution. We are committed to running a low dollar campaign, and every dollar we raise goes towards connecting us with voters in KY.

Please help spread awareness. If you know someone who might be interested in following our campaign, please consider forwarding this email to them, or asking them to subscribe. Let's bring more people into this conversation. I am excited as we head into the new year. Just a few hours until 2022 folks. With this new year come hopes and dreams of a better tomorrow for our country. I can't wait to meet more Kentuckians this new year as we together build a campaign and movement that can speak to people across the state and across political lines.
---
Together we can win this,

body:

This end-of-year goal isn't just an arbitrary random number. It was calculated by factoring in all of the benchmarks we missed and deficits we encountered throughout the whole year, as well as allocating necessary early resources to reach key voters at the start of 2022. In the event that we aren't able to catch up on time to close out 2021 at least breaking even, we'll inevitably need to scale back on our major campaign strategies at the start of the New Year. And that's going to put us in an extremely vulnerable position at the most pivotal point of this race. I hate to sound so blunt, but I'll never be anything but honest with you. Especially when asking you for money. But that's just the reality of where we are at financially right now. Folks—

I hope you’re enjoying the holiday, but I’ve been pacing in my office all
day. As soon as we enter 2022, Tim’s opponents will make even bigger ad
buys and hurl even nastier attacks at us.

But here’s the kicker: if we miss our end-of-year goal tonight (and it

attacks. I’m not kidding when I say that this could seriously jeopardize

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: Today is the last day
body:
Today is the last day!

Dear
Peter, over the past several years, I've devoted my life to
promoting my faith and my conservative principles. The reality is
that I'm not really doing this for myself. I'm doing this for my
children and my grandchildren.

I'm doing
all of this because I see our freedoms being eroded by government
overreach and progressives seeking to rewrite our nation's
history. Have you seen this too?

I want
the next generation to have the same freedoms that we had growing
up-the same freedoms guaranteed by our Founding Fathers.

This is
why this moment in time is so important. Together, we can make a
difference that will impact future generations for the better.
America is the greatest country that has ever existed and we must
do everything we can to make sure it stays that way.

Will you
help me fight for these freedoms?

If you
are able, consider making a tax-deductible donation by midnight
tonight to defend the freedoms for the next generation.

You can
donate at this secure link:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/year-end

I am so
excited about the future of the American Cornerstone Institute
and I am even more excited about the future of America.

Both
futures are bright because of you. I can't possibly thank you
enough for your support.

I hope
God blesses you in the new year.

Sincerely,
Dr. Ben
Carson

--
Dr. Ben
Carson

and Chairman

Cornerstone Institute

Friend, With a few hours before we ring in the New Year, I just wanted to take a moment to say: **thank you.** You are a big reason why I’m in this race. When I launched my campaign, a lot of people asked me, “**why** this race?” **I’m in this race for my father — an immigrant from Ecuador.** Like any migrant laborer, he went where the work was. We moved from Chicago to Newark to Cleveland as a kid. Because he was an immigrant, he had no choice but to go with wherever work was available — even if it meant uprooting the entire family. **I’m in this race for my mother.** She became a mother for the first time at 14 years old and would go on to raise five children. When I was a kid, I watched her, like millions of Americans, ration her insulin because she couldn’t afford the prescription she needed. **I’m in this race for my son: Michael Maximiliano Ortega.** He was born just a few months ago, and being a dad is one of the best things that’s ever happened to me. But I’m concerned about the air he’ll breathe and the water he’ll drink. I’m concerned about what we’re leaving behind for him — for his future. **I’m in this race for the people of Anaheim, Santa Ana, and the City of Orange.** American history — a story that's intertwined with workers rights and immigrant rights — is rooted in our neighborhood. This district deserves someone who knows their struggle — who’s _lived_ their struggle — and won’t just show up for photo ops. **We’re not in this race to get big checks from pharmaceutical companies or big oil and gas. We’re in this race to fight with you and for you.** [**So, with only a few hours left until our midnight grassroots fundraising deadline, please chip in $5, $10, or $25 to our campaign. clean_body: To fight the big fights. To fight for this district. | = Friend, With a few hours before we ring in the New Year, I just wanted to take a moment to say: thank you. You are a big reason why I’m in this race. When I launched my campaign, a lot of people asked me, “why this race?” I’m in this race for my father — an immigrant from Ecuador. Like any migrant laborer, he went where the work was. We moved from Chicago to Newark to Cleveland as a kid. Because he was an immigrant, he had no choice but to go with wherever work was available — even if it meant uprooting the entire family. I’m in this race for my mother. She became a mother for the first time at 14 years old and would go on to raise five children. When I was a kid, I watched her, like millions of Americans, ration her insulin because she couldn’t afford the prescription she needed. I’m in this race for my son: Michael Maximiliano Ortega. He was born just a few months ago, and being a dad is one of the best things that’s ever happened to me. But I’m concerned about the air he’ll breathe and the water he’ll drink. I’m concerned about what we’re leaving behind for him — for his future. I’m in this race for the people of Anaheim, Santa Ana, and the City of Orange. American history — a story that's intertwined with workers rights and immigrant rights — is rooted in our neighborhood. This district deserves someone who knows their struggle — who’s lived their struggle — and won’t just show up for photo ops. We’re not in this race to get big checks from pharmaceutical companies or big oil and gas. We’re in this race to fight with you and for you. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = | = ---|---|--- = | = | = I can’t wait to walk alongside you on the campaign trail. clean_body: It’s that time when McDonalds, Raytheon, Boeing, Verizon & Amazon lineup to support Danny Davis. | | | Dear team, At the end of each year, corporations and billionaires total up their profits and make one final investment for the year: they make corporate donations to elected officials all across the country. Last cycle, Danny Davis received 59 PAC donations in his end of year filing. In fact, 73% of his fundraising comes from corporations. My campaign is funded by people like you, team. As a Black woman running for office, I’ve had to work twice as hard as white candidates to fundraise for this campaign, and I’m rejecting all corporate PAC money at the same time. No matter what politicians say, corporate money comes with strings attached. When representatives choose to accept big checks from corporate PACs, they become accountable to those corporations instead of the voters that elected them. We need leaders who stand up for people not profits, and govern with a clear understanding of who they represent: the people. Thank you, Kina Collins | To give by check: Kina Collins for Congress 901 Lake Street, Unit 4093 Oak Park, IL 60301

Hey Team,

In the final hours before we welcome the New Year and close the books on our December fundraising deadline, I just want to take a moment to say thank you for everything you've done to make our campaign a success. Because of you, we've emerged as a frontrunner in this race, and I couldn't be more grateful.

That said, I wasn't exaggerating when I said we were getting ready for **the fight of our lives** earlier this week. Rescuing our economy from COVID.

Cutting poverty in America almost in half.

Passing a bipartisan infrastructure bill that will put Americans back to work, and speed our progress to clean energy.

name: Team AOC
subject: 2021 in photos
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Thank you for making this year so special.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20211231-2721-header&t=1&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
## A look back at 2021 in photos...
### January 2021
Alexandria joined a picket line with Teamsters Local 202 in The Bronx to support food and manufacturing workers on strike - they ultimately won their largest pay raise in 30 years.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
### February 2021
Alexandria visited with families impacted by the winter storm in Texas and worked with volunteers to provide food and water to those who were without power for days. Together, we raised over $5 million toward relief for families across the state.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
### April 2021
Alexandria and Senator Markey reintroduced the Green New Deal in Congress with 13 new cosponsors.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
Alexandria hosted an Earth Day celebration at Astoria Park to discuss the Green New Deal and the campaign’s work to stop the NRG power plant proposed for Astoria. (Which we later defeated!)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
### June 2021
In our local City Council elections, we organized our first slate of Courage to Change Candidates, all of whom committed to a series of policy pledges aimed at achieving social, racial and economic justice — and 16 of them won!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
### September 2021
After Hurricane Ida brought catastrophic, deadly flooding to New York City, AOC visited with families.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
Our team of volunteers went door to door to get resources and information out to affected neighborhoods for six straight weeks.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
### October 2021
Annual Halloween fair hosted by Team AOC at Pelham Bay Park. We know trick or treating can be tough in the City, so each year we bring the celebration to our families!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)
### November 2021
At Thanksgiving, we distributed over 170 turkeys to families in our district. And during the start of the school year, we provided 800 backpacks to students in need. We also raised $34K for local organizations doing food relief work this fall.
* * *
Thank you for making this year so special. None of this would be possible without your support.
We’re excited to continue growing and building with you in the year to come.
With thanks,
Team AOC
**[Donate today](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)**

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20211231-2?refcode=em20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&t=11&refcode2=2721_2526796_IgZ_Ht&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20211231-2721-P_FND_EOQ_GRM&t=12&akid=2721%2E2526796%2EIgZ_Ht)**

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Victoria Spartz for Congress
body:
Fellow Patriots,

When I announced my campaign for Congress last year, I did so with great hope for our country. We were dealing with unique and trying times, but our nation was on a path to continued success and prosperity. I could not have imagined that I would be a freshman Congresswoman in the minority, with a Democrat controlled Senate and White House.

Make no mistake, this wouldn’t have changed my decision to run, and if anything, makes my desire to serve that much stronger and more important. We cannot sit idly by as we watch the Democratic party moving further left and more dangerous by the day. We cannot allow our freedoms to be eroded and the fabric of our country to be torn. We cannot allow radical to become normal. Growing up under socialism, I have seen how things will become if we do allow it.

You hear it all the time – “This election is the most important of our lifetime.” As I announced my intention to seek re-election to another term representing Indiana’s 5^th District in 2022, I firmly believe that is the case.

Congress is broken. It doesn’t take someone serving there to see it. Political posturing, special interest influence, and the ever-increasing powers of Speaker Pelosi are dangerous, and the American people are tired of it.

>From my life experience, and simple common sense, I know we must continue to fight. We must fight for our American values, and return to the founding principles and individual freedoms that made our country great. We must return power to the people, not the political elites and lobbyists, and continue standing up for the individual, and what is right.

I am proud to serve, and know our work is just beginning. We have good things yet to accomplish, and bad things yet to prevent.

As we close out 2021 and move into the election year, we must do so on strong footing. I’m a thorn in the Speaker’s side, and she will want us gone. That is why I need your help.

Will you contribute to our campaign and ensure we have the resources we need to succeed in re-election? A donation of $25, $50, $100, $1,000 or any amount before the end of the year will be greatly appreciated.

Thank you for your continued support, and all you do for our party, state, and country.

Warmest regards,

Victoria

P.S. Please make your contribution today to ensure we reach our end-of-year fundraising goal. You may contribute online below, or by mailing a check to “Spartz for Congress,” PO Box Box 505, Noblesville, IN 46061.

body:
Fellow Patriots,

When I announced my campaign for Congress last year, I did so with great hope for our country. We were dealing with unique and trying times, but our nation was on a path to continued success and prosperity. I could not have imagined that I would be a freshman Congresswoman in the minority, with a Democrat controlled Senate and White House.

Make no mistake, this wouldn’t have changed my decision to run, and if anything, makes my desire to serve that much stronger and more important. We cannot sit idly by as we watch the Democrat party moving further left and more dangerous by the day. We cannot allow our freedoms to be eroded and the fabric of our country to be torn. We cannot allow radical to become normal. Growing up under socialism, I have seen how things will become if we do allow it.

You hear it all the time – “This election is the most important of our lifetime.” As I announced my intention to seek re-election to another term representing Indiana’s 5^th District in 2022, I firmly believe that is the case.

Congress is broken. It doesn’t take someone serving there to see it. Political posturing, special interest influence, and the ever-increasing powers of Speaker Pelosi are dangerous, and the American people are tired of it.

>From my life experience, and simple common sense, I know we must continue to fight. We must fight for our American values, and return to the founding principles and individual freedoms that made our country great. We must return power to the people, not the political elites and lobbyists, and continue standing up for the individual, and what is right.

I am proud to serve, and know our work is just beginning. We have good things yet to accomplish, and bad things yet to prevent.

As we close out 2021 and move into the election year, we must do so on strong footing. I’m a thorn in the Speaker’s side, and she will want us gone. That is why I need your help.

Will you contribute to our campaign and ensure we have the resources we need to succeed in re-election? A donation of $25, $50, $100, $1,000 or any amount before the end of the year will be greatly appreciated.

Thank you for your continued support, and all you do for our party, state, and country.

Warmest regards,

Victoria

P.S. Please make your contribution today to ensure we reach our end-of-year fundraising goal. You may contribute online below, or by mailing a check to “Spartz for Congress,” PO Box Box 505, Noblesville, IN 46061.

You hear it all the time – “This election is the most important of our lifetime.” As I announced my intention to seek re-election to another term representing Indiana’s 5^th District in 2022, I firmly believe that is the case. Congress is broken. It doesn’t take someone serving there to see it. Political posturing, special interest influence, and the ever-increasing powers of Speaker Pelosi are dangerous, and the American people are tired of it. From my life experience, and simple common sense, I know we must continue to fight. We must fight for our American values, and return to the founding principles and individual freedoms that made our country great. We must return power to the people, not the political elites and lobbyists, and continue standing up for the individual, and what is right. I am proud to serve, and know our work is just beginning. We have good things yet to accomplish, and bad things yet to prevent. As we close out 2021 and move into the election year, we must do so on strong footing. I’m a thorn in the Speaker’s side, and she will want us gone. That is why I need your help. Will you contribute to our campaign and ensure we have the resources we need to succeed in re-election? A donation of $25, $50, $100, $1,000 or any amount before the end of the year will be greatly appreciated. Thank you for your continued support, and all you do for our party, state, and country. Warmest regards, Victoria P.S. Please make your contribution today to ensure we reach our end-of-year fundraising goal. One last message from me before we close the books for 2021.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20211231-485-footer-ak&t=2&akid=485%2E90090%2EkzfWoI)
Hey, it’s Morgan! First, I want to wish you a very happy new year, and I want to thank you for taking the time to open this email from me — it really means a lot to me.
Second, I want to be frank with you. The last thing I want to do on a holiday is waste your time. **Today marks our campaign’s last FEC deadline of 2021**. And just a few hours from now, at midnight tonight, our books will close and everything we’ve raised this quarter will become public knowledge. _Right now, what we’ve raised is not enough._
[**_Please, if you can afford it, can you rush a contribution to our campaign before midnight tonight?_**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/19479?t=3&akid=485%2E90090%2EkzfWoI)

As a Black woman who isn’t afraid to stand up for what’s right – whether it was as a lawyer, a community organizer, or now as a candidate – I’m used to being counted out.
Our public fundraising numbers can change the game and make _all_ of our opponents take the strength of our campaign seriously. **And right now****, we’re seriously behind.**
[**_That’s why I’m humbly asking you to not look away. Don’t close out of this email. Don’t scroll away. And just a few hours from now, at midnight tonight, our books will close and everything we’ve raised this quarter will become public knowledge. Right now, what we’ve raised is not enough. As a Black woman who isn’t afraid to stand up for what’s right – whether it was as a lawyer, a community organizer, or now as a candidate – I’m used to being counted out. Our public fundraising numbers can change the game and make all of our opponents take the strength of our campaign seriously. And right now, we’re seriously behind. Yours in solidarity, Morgan Morgan for U.S. Senate in Ohio | | Email us: contact@morganharper.org

As our team waits for the New Year’s Eve ball to drop, we can’t help but think about what’s next for this campaign.
#
We know it’s late, Derek.
But as our team waits for the New Year’s Eve ball to drop, we can’t help but think about what’s next for this campaign.
**[So please, let us explain why supporting our campaign with a $5 donation before MIDNIGHT is the *most* important thing you can do to help this campaign right now.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/39086?refcode=em20211231-4038&amounts=5&t=1&akid=4038%2E434096%2EIQR1Uu)**
We’ll just start out by saying this: **Starting at 12:00 AM, we’re officially in a critical midterm election year. All eyes will be on Pennsylvania + our campaign.**
Starting tomorrow, we have just over 11 months to build the strongest, most far-reaching campaign that PA has *ever* seen, and every single dollar you donate NOW makes an incredible difference.
Here’s the other thing, Derek: The razor-thin Democratic Senate majority could all come down to Pennsylvania. This Senate seat is gonna be a real toss-up.
That’s why **CNN has consistently rated Pennsylvania as the #1 Most Likely to Flip Democratic state in the country.** We all remember what happened when Pennsylvania flipped the _other way_ in 2016. That’s why building support for the long road ahead is so critical right now.
With this in mind, we are respectfully asking one last time for your support before the end-of-year fundraising deadline:
**[Can you kick in a $5 donation to our campaign for U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania? This is your last chance to make an impact this year and help us meet our $2 million goal.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/39086?refcode=em20211231-4038&amounts=5&t=2&akid=4038%2E434096%2EIQR1Uu)**

When the clock strikes midnight tonight, we hope you take the time to celebrate with your loved ones. Know that while we are celebrating, we’re also thinking of all of you.
With endless gratitude,
Team Fetterman

clean_body: My friend, It is finally the end of the year, and what a year it has been. I proudly announced my candidacy for governor on September 8th , and we have been full steam ahead ever since! In just four months on the campaign trail, we have already attended more than 250 events across Minnesota! Throughout my discussions with concerned voters, there has been one resounding point I have heard: Minnesota deserves better than the failed policies of Tim Walz. Recently, at State Central, many of you made it clear that this is more than a campaign — it's a movement. I won their straw poll with 37% of the vote, proving that I am the candidate best positioned to defeat Tim Walz. As we move forward into 2022, it's important that this movement continue to be about what's important: you! That's why I have made it a priority to make sure that I personally talk one-on-one with so many of you. I have already made hundreds of phone calls and learned how Tim Walz's policies have negatively effected so many of you. In order to ensure we get Minnesota back on track, I need your help. Thank you, Paul Gazelka | | | | ---|---|--- Paid for and Provided by Gazelka for Governor P.O. Box 175 Little Falls, MN 56345
